jobs.description:
Die Bachem-Gruppe investiert in einen neuen geplanten Standort im Sisslerfeld in der Nordwestschweiz. Dieser Schritt ist Teil der langfristigen Strategie, die Produktionskapazitäten bis zum Ende des Jahrzehnts auszubauen. Der neue Produktionsstandort wird eine zentrale Rolle bei der Erreichung dieser Ziele spielen. Die Planungsphase des Projekts bietet Ihnen einzigartige Möglichkeiten, die Organisation der Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, sind wir stets auf der Suche nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Technical Operations suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als PI Server Data Historian Engineer - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100%

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Aufbau, Konfiguration und Validierung des PI Systems als zentrale Datendrehscheibe für Prozessdaten

• Anbindung von Automatisierungssystemen (z. B. Siemens PCS 7, später PCS neo) sowie dem MES System (PAS-X) an den Historian

• Umsetzung von GMP-konformen Anforderungen an Datenintegrität, Audit Trail, Data Retention, Redundanz und Zugriffssicherheit

• Entwicklung von Tag-Strukturen, AF (Asset Framework), Event Frames und Schnittstellen zu Reporting-Systemen

• Unterstützung bei der Integration von PI Vision und anderen Tools für Betriebsanalysen, Prozessmonitoring und Batch Reporting

• Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, QA und IT sowie globalen Einheiten zur Sicherstellung der Compliance und Systemverfügbarkeit

• Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Unterstützung bei der Qualifizierung (z. B. URS, FS, IQ/OQ)

• Unterstützung bei Trainings, Wartung und Betrieb des Systems in der kommerziellen Phase

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Ingenieurwesen, Informatik, Automatisierungstechnik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit OSIsoft / AVEVA PI System in regulierten Umgebungen (idealerweise Pharma / GMP)

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Integration von PCS 7 (und idealerweise PCS neo) sowie MES Systemen wie PAS-X

• Erfahrung mit PI Systemkomponenten wie PI Data Archive, PI Asset Framework, PI Interfaces, PI Vision

• Verständnis für GMP-Vorgaben, insbesondere im Hinblick auf Datenintegrität und Systemvalidierung

• Kenntnisse in Skriptsprachen (z. B. PowerShell, Python, VB, C++, JavaScript, Powershell) und Netzwerktechnologien von Vorteil

• Erfahrung in der Administration von Windows und Windows Server Systemen

• Kenntnisse im Bereich IT System / Software Qualifizierung (GMP, GAMP, CSV)

• Grundkenntnisse im Bereich Automatisierung (OPC UA) von Vorteil

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie strukturierte, dokumentationsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

• Firmeninterne KITA auf dem Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Zugang zu Vorteilsplattformen mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

• Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

• Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

Möchten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Innovationen vorantreiben?

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Bewerbungsportal.

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Bachem Gruppe und lassen Sie sich von unserem inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Stein begeistern!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Il Gruppo Bachem investe in un nuovo sito progettato a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passaggio rientra nella strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva entro la fine del decennio. Il nuovo sito produttivo svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. La fase di progettazione del progetto vi offre opportunità uniche per modellare attivamente l'organizzazione del futuro.

Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo sempre alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel campo delle operazioni tecniche, siamo alla ricerca di una persona impegnata come Lead Facility Management - Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100%

Compiti

jobs.title: Technical Author (a) 100%
jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

As a Technical Author (a) 100% you will play an important role in developing, maintaining, and ensuring the quality of GMP documentation for API manufacturing at our site in Stein. You will work at the interface between Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and R&D and contribute to technology transfer, process scale-up, and the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes. With your structured and detail-oriented approach, you will help ensure compliant, robust, and efficient manufacturing operations.

Your Tasks

• Prepare, review, and maintain GMP documentation for API manufacturing, including Manufacturing Instructions, SOPs, Process Validation Plans, and Validation Reports.

• Support technology transfer and scale-up activities, translating production processes into clear and compliant manufacturing documentation.

• Conduct gap and risk assessments and support the development of appropriate concepts, strategies, and rationales.

• Act as a key interface between Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and R&D to align technical and documentation requirements.

• Coordinate documentation activities and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality documentation in line with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

• Maintain GMP documentation in an up-to-date and compliant state during routine operations.

• Support process improvements and the investigation of complex, non-routine deviations, including the implementation and documentation of resulting CAPAs.

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of Master Batch Records (MBRs) within Bachem's Manufacturing Execution System (PAS-X).

Your Profile

• Master's degree or PhD in Chemistry, or a degree in a natural science discipline combined with relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience or strong interest in preparing and managing GMP documentation in a pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated environment.

• Ability to understand, describe, and document technical processes and chemical manufacturing processes clearly and accurately.

• Native-level German and excellent English language skills, both written and spoken.

• Highly structured, accurate, and detail-oriented working style with a strong sense of accountability.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.

• Experience with MES-based Master Batch Record design or knowledge of PAS-X is an advantage; willingness to learn is essential.

Our offer:

• The role offers broad exposure across global Technical Operations and Innovation Platforms and close collaboration with senior stakeholders, enabling strong professional visibility and the opportunity to shape groupwide innovation long-term.

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to shape global Operational Readiness frameworks with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and our working environment at the Bubendorf site on our website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo Bachem sta investendo in un nuovo sito pianificato a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva entro la fine del decennio. Il nuovo sito di produzione svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. La fase progettuale del progetto offre opportunità uniche per modellare l'organizzazione futura.

Come Autore Tecnico (a) 100% si svolgerà un ruolo importante nello sviluppo, nel mantenimento e nella garanzia della qualità della documentazione GMP per la produzione API presso il nostro sito a Stein. Potrai lavorare all'interfaccia tra Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs e R&D e contribuire al trasferimento tecnologico, alla scala di processo e al miglioramento continuo dei processi produttivi. Con il vostro approccio strutturato e orientato al dettaglio, vi aiuterà a garantire operazioni di produzione conformi, robuste ed efficienti.

I vostri compiti

• Preparare, rivedere e mantenere la documentazione GMP per la produzione di API, comprese le istruzioni di fabbricazione, le SOP, i piani di convalida dei processi e i rapporti di convalida.

• Supporta le attività di trasferimento tecnologico e di scale-up, traducendo i processi produttivi in una documentazione di produzione chiara e conforme.

• Condurre le valutazioni dei rischi e sostenere lo sviluppo di concetti, strategie e razionali appropriati.

• Agire come interfaccia chiave tra Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs e R&D per allineare i requisiti tecnici e di documentazione.

• Coordinare le attività di documentazione e garantire la consegna tempestiva di documentazione di alta qualità in linea con gli standard interni e requisiti normativi.

• Mantenere la documentazione GMP in uno stato aggiornato e conforme durante le operazioni di routine.

• Miglioramenti del processo di sostegno e l'indagine di deviazioni complesse e non routine, tra cui l'attuazione e la documentazione della CAPA risultante.

• Contribuisci alla creazione e alla manutenzione di Master Batch Records (MBR) all'interno del sistema di esecuzione di Bachem (PAS-X).

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in chimica, o una laurea in una disciplina di scienze naturali combinata con esperienza rilevante nell'industria farmaceutica.

• Esperienza o forte interesse nella preparazione e nella gestione della documentazione GMP in un ambiente farmaceutico o regolamentato da GMP.

• Capacità di comprendere, descrivere e documentare processi tecnici e processi produttivi chimici in modo chiaro e preciso.

• Competenze di lingua tedesca e inglese eccellenti, sia scritte che parlate.

• Stile di lavoro altamente strutturato, accurato e orientato al dettaglio con un forte senso di responsabilità.

• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e competenze di coordinamento, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente attraverso le funzioni.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestire più priorità e fornire risultati di alta qualità entro tempi concordati.

• L'esperienza con il Master Batch Record basato su MES design o la conoscenza di PAS-X è un vantaggio; la volontà di imparare è essenziale.

La nostra offerta:

• Il ruolo offre un'ampia esposizione sulle piattaforme globali di gestione tecnica e innovazione e una stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder senior, consentendo una forte visibilità professionale e l'opportunità di modellare l'innovazione a lungo termine.

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Sviluppo dei dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

descriptionByLocale.de:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

As a Technical Author (a) 100% you will play an important role in developing, maintaining, and ensuring the quality of GMP documentation for API manufacturing at our site in Stein. You will work at the interface between Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and R&D and contribute to technology transfer, process scale-up, and the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes. With your structured and detail-oriented approach, you will help ensure compliant, robust, and efficient manufacturing operations.

Your Tasks

• Prepare, review, and maintain GMP documentation for API manufacturing, including Manufacturing Instructions, SOPs, Process Validation Plans, and Validation Reports.

• Support technology transfer and scale-up activities, translating production processes into clear and compliant manufacturing documentation.

• Conduct gap and risk assessments and support the development of appropriate concepts, strategies, and rationales.

• Act as a key interface between Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and R&D to align technical and documentation requirements.

• Coordinate documentation activities and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality documentation in line with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

• Maintain GMP documentation in an up-to-date and compliant state during routine operations.

• Support process improvements and the investigation of complex, non-routine deviations, including the implementation and documentation of resulting CAPAs.

• Contribute to the creation and maintenance of Master Batch Records (MBRs) within Bachem's Manufacturing Execution System (PAS-X).

Your Profile

• Master's degree or PhD in Chemistry, or a degree in a natural science discipline combined with relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience or strong interest in preparing and managing GMP documentation in a pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated environment.

• Ability to understand, describe, and document technical processes and chemical manufacturing processes clearly and accurately.

• Native-level German and excellent English language skills, both written and spoken.

• Highly structured, accurate, and detail-oriented working style with a strong sense of accountability.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.

• Experience with MES-based Master Batch Record design or knowledge of PAS-X is an advantage; willingness to learn is essential.

Avec votre approche structurée et axée sur les détails, vous contribuerez à assurer des opérations de fabrication conformes, robustes et efficaces.

• Amélioration du processus d'appui et étude des écarts complexes et non courants, y compris la mise en oeuvre et la documentation des APC qui en résultent.

• Contribuer à la création et à la maintenance de Master Batch Records (MBR) au sein du système d'exécution de fabrication de Bachem (PAS-X).

Votre profil

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en chimie, ou diplôme en sciences naturelles associé à une expérience pertinente dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

• Expérience ou grand intérêt pour la préparation et la gestion de la documentation sur les BPF dans un environnement pharmaceutique ou réglementé par les BPF.

• Capacité à comprendre, décrire et documenter les processus techniques et les procédés de fabrication de produits chimiques de façon claire et précise.

• Niveau natif allemand et excellentes compétences en langue anglaise, à la fois écrite et parlée.

• Un style de travail très structuré, précis et axé sur les détails, avec un fort sens de la responsabilité.

• Excellente capacité de communication, de gestion des intervenants et de coordination, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre les fonctions.

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de gérer plusieurs priorités et d'obtenir des résultats de haute qualité dans les délais convenus.

• L'expérience de la conception ou de la connaissance du PAS-X de Master Batch Record basé sur MES est un avantage; la volonté d'apprendre est essentielle.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned location in Sisslerfeld in northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacities by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The planning phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to actively shape the organization of the future.

As part of the planned site development, the System Expert Materials Management Sisslerfeld Site Development (a) 100% ensures that material management processes are mapped efficiently, GMP-compliant and sustainable in the planned systems. The role significantly contributes to the development and successful commissioning of digital solutions for storage, production supply, sampling, dispensing, tank farm management and disposal processes.

Their tasks:

• Active participation in the development of the new location and in the design of the future materials management organization

• Representation of the requirements of the operator organisation in the design, implementation and further development of the system landscape

• Development and optimization of end-to-end processes taking into account organizational, operational and systemic interfaces

• Translation of professional requirements into sustainable digital solutions in cooperation with engineering, IT and external partners

• Participation in the conception and further development of ERP, WMS, MES and other relevant systems and business processes

• Planning, implementation and support of tests, qualification and commissioning activities from the perspective of the future operator organisation

• Examination and professional approval of project-relevant documents as well as ensuring compliance with safety, environmental and quality requirements

• Support building a powerful, efficient and digitally supported materials management organization

Your profile:

• Higher education in logistics, supply chain management, business informatics, industrial engineering or a comparable discipline

• Several years of experience in the conception, introduction or further development of business processes and digital solutions

• Strong understanding of end-to-end processes and their organizational and systemic mapping

• Very good knowledge of integrated system landscapes, especially in the environment of ERP, WMS and MES; Experience with SAP or SAP-related logistics processes and SAP EWM is advantageous

• Experience in the project environment as well as in cooperation with interdisciplinary teams and different stakeholders

• Experience in a regulated production environment, ideally in the pharmaceutical, chemical or similar industry, is beneficial

• Analytical and structured personality with strong end-to-end thinking and the ability to transform complex relationships into workable solutions

• High level of initiative, a sense of responsibility and strong communication as well as the pleasure of helping to shape new structures and solutions in a dynamic project environment

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further education opportunities

• Flexible working hours with the option of home office and the option to purchase additional holidays with reduced workload

jobs.title: Technical Author (a) 100%
jobs.description:
Bachem is a world leader in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides for the pharmaceutical industry. To strengthen our Technical Operations team in Vionnaz (Valais, Switzerland), we are looking for a Technical Author (all) 100% .

As a key member of TechOps, you will create and maintain GMP manufacturing documentation, support technology transfer and new product introduction projects, and ensure process knowledge is translated into compliant, manufacturing-ready records. You will also contribute to the implementation of eMBPR and the digitalization of manufacturing documentation.

Your key responsibilities

• Create, review, and maintain GMP documentation supporting manufacturing operations and technology transfer activities.

• Prepare Master Batch Production Records (MBPRs), manufacturing instructions, protocols, reports, and related technical documents.

• Translate process knowledge and development data into compliant, manufacturing-ready documentation.

• Collaborate closely with Process Scientists, laboratory teams, Manufacturing, and Quality Assurance.

• Support technology transfer projects from process familiarization through commercial implementation.

• Participate in new product introduction projects and manufacturing readiness activities.

• Ensure documentation complies with GMP requirements, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations.

• Contribute to the implementation of eMBPR and the standardization and digitalization of manufacturing documentation.

Your Profile

• Master's degree or PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong scientific background with a solid understanding of chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or chemical environment.

• Experience in technical writing, manufacturing documentation, technology transfer, or process development.

• Familiarity with batch record creation and document management systems.

• Excellent technical writing skills with strong attention to detail and a structured approach.

• Fluent in French and English (minimum C1 level). German is a strong asset.

• Proactive team player with strong organizational and communication skills;

Our offer

• A modern and dynamic working environment within a fast-growing international company.

• Challenging projects of high scientific and technical value.

• Opportunities for professional development and continuing professional development.

• A corporate culture based on collaboration, innovation and excellence.

• Attractive working conditions and competitive employee benefits.

Interested?

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Vionnaz.

jobs.description:
Bachem is a world leader in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides for the pharmaceutical industry. To support our continued growth in Vionnaz (Valais, Switzerland), we are looking for a Group Leader TechOps Laboratories 100% (all). In this strategic role, you will lead the Optimization & Troubleshooting Laboratory and play a key part in technology transfer, process development, manufacturing support, and continuous improvement initiatives within our Technical Operations organization.

Your Responsibilities

•
 Lead, coach, and develop a team of laboratory professionals while promoting a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

•
 Coordinate laboratory activities supporting technology transfers, process familiarization, scale-up, and new product introductions.

•
 Ensure manufacturing readiness through process optimization and generation of critical process knowledge.

•
 Provide scientific and technical expertise to manufacturing operations and support strategic product introductions.

•
 Lead troubleshooting investigations related to process deviations, yield losses, quality events, and manufacturing challenges.

•
 Drive root cause analyses (RCA), risk assessments, FMEAs, and corrective action implementation.

•
 Promote technical excellence by identifying innovative technologies, industry best practices, and digitalization opportunities.

•
 Ensure compliance with GMP, HSE, quality requirements, and corporate procedures while maintaining high-quality technical documentation.

Your Profile

•
 PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.

•
 Minimum 5 years of experience in process development, manufacturing support, technology transfer, or industrial chemistry.

•
 Proven leadership experience in a laboratory, technical, manufacturing, or pharmaceutical environment.

•
 Strong experience in troubleshooting, root cause investigations, and process optimization.

•
 Solid understanding of GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

•
 Experience in peptide manufacturing, LPPS and/or SPPS is a strong advantage.

•
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across global and cross-functional teams.

•
 Fluent in English and French (minimum C1); German is an advantage.

Our offer

•
 A modern and dynamic working environment within a fast-growing international company.

•
 Challenging projects of high scientific and technical value.

•
 Opportunities for professional development and continuing professional development.

•
 A corporate culture based on collaboration, innovation and excellence.

•
 Attractive working conditions and competitive employee benefits.

Interested ?

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Vionnaz.

jobs.title: HSE Specialist (a) 100%
jobs.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides for the pharmaceutical industry. To strengthen our HSE organization in Vionnaz (Valais, Switzerland), we are looking for an HSE Specialist 100% (all). In this role, you will support site investment projects by ensuring that Health, Safety and Environment requirements are integrated throughout the project lifecycle, from design to commissioning, while promoting safe, compliant, and sustainable operations.

Your Responsibilities

• Act as the HSE representative for site CAPEX projects and technology transfers, ensuring HSE requirements are integrated from the earliest design stages through commissioning.

• Promote Safety by Design principles and risk reduction at source throughout project execution.

• Organize and participate in risk assessments, including HAZOP, PHA, ATEX, fire, ergonomic, and environmental assessments.

• Support PSSR and Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensure implementation of preventive and protective measures.

• Ensure compliance with legal requirements, company standards, and industry best practices, and verify their integration into project documentation and specifications.

• Define and monitor contractor HSE requirements and oversee high-risk activities during construction, installation, and commissioning phases.

• Contribute to inspections, audits, investigations, and the sharing of lessons learned following incidents or near misses.

• Deliver HSE awareness and training activities while driving continuous improvement initiatives across project teams.

Your Profile

• Higher education qualification in HSE, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field; additional training in project management or process safety is an advantage.

• At least five years of experience in an HSE role within a regulated industrial environment such as the chemical, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology industry.

• Experience supporting investment, expansion, or facility modification projects.

• Proven experience conducting or facilitating industrial risk assessments and working with contractors on industrial sites.

• Strong knowledge of process safety, risk management principles, and industrial safety regulations.

• Familiarity with ATEX, fire protection, environmental protection, industrial hygiene, SIS principles, and OPAM requirements is highly desirable.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix organization.

• Fluent French and professional proficiency in English; German and experience with HSE management systems are advantageous.

Our offer

• A modern and dynamic working environment within a fast-growing international company.

• Challenging projects of high scientific and technical value.

• Opportunities for professional development and continuing professional development.

• A corporate culture based on collaboration, innovation and excellence.

• Attractive working conditions and competitive employee benefits.

Interested

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bachelor è un'azienda leader e innovativa specializzata nello sviluppo e nella produzione di peptidi e oligonucleotidi per l'industria farmaceutica. Per rafforzare la nostra organizzazione HSE a Vionnaz (Valais, Svizzera), stiamo cercando un HSE Specialist 100% (tutti). In questo ruolo, supporterete i progetti di investimento del sito assicurando che i requisiti di salute, sicurezza e ambiente siano integrati attraverso il ciclo di vita del progetto, dalla progettazione alla messa in servizio, promuovendo al contempo operazioni sicure, conformi e sostenibili.

Le tue responsabilità

• Agire come rappresentante HSE per i progetti e i trasferimenti tecnologici del sito CAPEX, assicurando che i requisiti HSE siano integrati dalle prime fasi di progettazione attraverso la messa in servizio.

• Promuovere la sicurezza con i principi di progettazione e la riduzione del rischio alla fonte durante l'esecuzione del progetto.

• Organizzazione e partecipante a valutazioni di rischio, tra cui HAZOP, PHA, ATEX, antincendio, ergonomia e valutazioni ambientali.

• Sostenere i processi PSSR e Management of Change (MOC) e garantire l'attuazione di misure preventive e protettive.

• Assicurare la conformità ai requisiti legali, agli standard aziendali e alle best practice del settore e verificare la loro integrazione nella documentazione e nelle specifiche del progetto.

• Definire e monitorare i requisiti HSE e le attività all'estero ad alto rischio durante le fasi di costruzione, installazione e messa in servizio.

• Contribuisce a ispezioni, audit, indagini, e la condivisione delle lezioni apprese a seguito di incidenti o vicino manca.

• Offrire attività di sensibilizzazione e formazione HSE mentre guida iniziative di miglioramento continuo tra i team di progetto.

Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione superiore in HSE, Ingegneria, Chimica, o un campo correlato; formazione supplementare nella gestione del progetto o la sicurezza del processo è un vantaggio.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza in un ruolo HSE in un ambiente industriale regolamentato come l'industria chimica, farmaceutica o biotecnologia.

• Esperienza che supporta progetti di investimento, espansione o modifica.

• Esperienza comprovata conducendo o facilitando le valutazioni dei rischi industriali e lavorando con gli appaltatori sui siti industriali.

• Forte conoscenza della sicurezza dei processi, dei principi di gestione dei rischi e delle normative di sicurezza industriale.

• La familiarità con ATEX, protezione antincendio, protezione ambientale, igiene industriale, principi SIS e requisiti OPAM è altamente auspicabile.

• Forte capacità analitiche, organizzative, di comunicazione e di influenza, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un'organizzazione di matrice.

• Facoltà francese e professionale fluido in inglese; tedesco e l'esperienza con sistemi di gestione HSE sono attraenti.

La nostra offerta

• Un ambiente di lavoro moderno e dinamico all'interno di una società internazionale in rapida crescita.

• Progetti di alto valore scientifico e tecnico.

• Opportunità per lo sviluppo professionale e lo sviluppo professionale continuo.

• Una cultura aziendale basata sulla collaborazione, l'innovazione e l'eccellenza.

• Condizioni di lavoro interessanti e vantaggi competitivi dei dipendenti.

Interessi

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite la nostra applicazione portale.

Scopri di più sul Bachelor Group e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra posizione a Vionnaz.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bachelor ist ein führendes, innovationsgetriebenes Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Peptiden und Oligonukleotiden für die pharmazeutische Industrie spezialisiert hat. Um unsere HSE-Organisation in Vionnaz (Valais, Schweiz) zu stärken, suchen wir einen HSE-Spezialisten 100% (alle). In dieser Rolle unterstützen Sie Investitionsprojekte vor Ort, indem Sie sicherstellen, dass Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Umweltanforderungen während des Projektlebenszyklus, von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme, integriert werden und gleichzeitig einen sicheren, konformen und nachhaltigen Betrieb fördern.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Handeln Sie als HSE-Vertreter für CAPEX-Projekte und Technologietransfers, um sicherzustellen, dass die HSE-Anforderungen von den frühen Entwurfsphasen bis zur Inbetriebnahme integriert werden.

• Förderung von Safety by Design-Prinzipien und Risikominderung an der Quelle während der gesamten Projektdurchführung.

• Organisation und Teilnehmer an Risikobewertungen, einschließlich HAZOP, PHA, ATEX, Brand-, Ergonomie- und Umweltbewertungen.

• Unterstützung von PSSR- und Management of Change-Prozessen (MOC) und Gewährleistung der Umsetzung von Präventiv- und Schutzmaßnahmen.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Anforderungen, Unternehmensstandards und Best Practices der Branche und Überprüfung ihrer Integration in die Projektdokumentation und -spezifikationen.

• Definieren und überwachen Sie die HSE-Anforderungen und risikoreiche Aktivitäten im Ausland während der Bau-, Installations- und Inbetriebnahmephasen.

• Trägt zu Inspektionen, Audits, Untersuchungen und zum Austausch von Erfahrungen bei Vorfällen oder Beinaheunfällen bei.

• Bereitstellung von HSE-Sensibilisierungs- und Schulungsmaßnahmen, während kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Projektteams vorangetrieben werden.

Ihr Profil

• Hochschulqualifikation in HSE, Engineering, Chemie oder einem verwandten Bereich; zusätzliche Ausbildung in Projektmanagement oder Prozesssicherheit ist von Vorteil.

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer HSE-Rolle in einem regulierten industriellen Umfeld wie der chemischen, pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen Industrie.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Investitions-, Erweiterungs- oder Vereinfachungsprojekten.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Durchführung oder Erleichterung industrieller Risikobewertungen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Auftragnehmern an Industriestandorten.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Prozesssicherheit, Risikomanagementprinzipien und industrielle Sicherheitsvorschriften.

• Die Vertrautheit mit ATEX, Brandschutz, Umweltschutz, Industriehygiene, SIS-Prinzipien und OPAM-Anforderungen ist sehr wünschenswert.

• Starke analytische, organisatorische, kommunikative und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer Matrixorganisation zu arbeiten.

• Fließend Französisch und professionelle Fakultät in Englisch; Deutsch und Erfahrung mit HSE-Managementsystemen sind attraktiv.

Unser Angebot

• Ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld in einem schnell wachsenden internationalen Unternehmen.

• Challending-Projekte von hohem wissenschaftlichen und technischen Wert.

• Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Weiterbildung.

• Eine Unternehmenskultur, die auf Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Exzellenz basiert.

• Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen und wettbewerbsfähige Arbeitnehmerleistungen.

Interesse

Möchten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Innovationen vorantreiben?

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen über unsere Portalbewerbung.

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Bachelor-Gruppe und lassen Sie sich von unserem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Vionnaz inspirieren.

jobs.title: QC Lab Technician (a) 100%
jobs.description:
Afin de renforcer notre équipe Contrôle Qualité, nous recherchons un  Laborantin Contrôle Qualité (all), 100%  pour notre site de Production de Vionnaz (Valais/Wallis, Suisse).

Vos Missions

• Analyse des matières premières, produits en cours de fabrication et des produits finis

• Contrôle et signature des analyses du laboratoire

• Contrôle et entretient des appareils de laboratoire

• Gestion de la documentation

• Echantillonnage des matières

• Participation à la validation de méthodes analytiques

• Suivi des procédures de qualité (GMP) et de sécurité (EHS)

• Identifier les axes d’amélioration des procédures et contribuer à leur mise en œuvre.

• Participer activement à des groupes d’optimisation (qualité, sécurité, normes)

Votre Profil

• Titulaire d'un CFC de laborantin(e) en chimie, vous disposez de compétences techniques analytiques physico-chimiques et chromatographiques (HPLC et GC).

• Vous bénéficiez d’une expérience dans un environnement industriel chimique et/ou pharmaceutique.

• Les normes GMP vous sont familières.

• La connaissance de LIMS et / ou de Chromeleon est un atout.

• Vous êtes organisé(e) et méthodique.

• Vous êtes flexible et disposé à travailler en horaire décalé ~ 1x / semaine.

• Vous soutenez le Contrôle Qualité dans toutes ses tâches. Et aimez travailler en équipe.

• Vous parlez français.

• Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels.

jobs.title: QC Analytical Project Manager (a) 100%
jobs.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides for the pharmaceutical industry. To strengthen our Quality Control organization in Vionnaz (Valais, Switzerland), we are looking for a QC Analytical Project Manager (all) 100% . In this cross-functional role, you will coordinate analytical activities throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring successful delivery of customer projects while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and operational excellence.

Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary QC Analytical Operations representative within cross-functional project teams.

• Lead and coordinate analytical activities including release testing, stability studies, API characterization, method development, validation, and specification setting.

• Manage analytical transfers to internal departments, manufacturing sites, and external partners.

• Evaluate complex analytical data, provide scientific recommendations, and communicate results to customers and stakeholders.

• Define and implement analytical and quality control strategies aligned with customer needs and Bachem best practices.

• Monitor project timelines, budgets, resources, quality events, deviations, CAPAs, and change controls.

• Organize and facilitate project meetings while ensuring effective collaboration between internal and external partners.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with GMP, regulatory, quality, and safety requirements.

Your Profile

•
 Degree in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline (or equivalent industrial experience).

•
 Proven experience in project management within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment.

•
 Strong understanding of analytical methods, method development, validation, and international pharmacopoeias.

•
 Good knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory requirements and quality systems.

•
 Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and successfully manage cross-functional projects.

•
 Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

•
 Excellent command of MS Office and project management tools; experience with LIMS, CDS, MasterControl, and SAP is an advantage.

•
 Fluent in French and English; German is considered a plus.

Our offer

•
 A modern and dynamic working environment within a fast-growing international company.

•
 Challenging projects of high scientific and technical value.

•
 Opportunities for professional development and continuing professional development.

•
 A corporate culture based on collaboration, innovation and excellence.

•
 Attractive working conditions and competitive employee benefits.

Interested ?

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Vionnaz.

jobs.description:
Afin de renforcer notre équipe Production, nous recherchons un  Technologue en Production Chimique et Pharmaceutique (CFC) (a), 100%  pour notre site de Production de Vionnaz (Valais/Wallis, Suisse).

Vos missions principales

• Connaître et suivre les procédures et directives HSE en vigueur pour garantir la sécurité des opérations et le respect de l’environnement.

• Contribuer à la fabrication d’un produit pharmaceutique, depuis la commande des matières premières jusqu’au conditionnement du produit fini.

• Réaliser les opérations de chargement des réacteurs au sein des installations industrielles.

• Effectuer les activités annexes de production : échantillonnage, étiquetage, nettoyage des installations et bâtiments, maintien de l’ordre selon les principes du 5S.

• Détecter et signaler toute déviation éventuelle.

• Participer activement à l’amélioration continue des processus.

• Travailler en équipes (3x8) du dimanche soir au vendredi soir

Votre profil

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC de technologue en production chimique et pharmaceutique, ou d'une formation jugée équivalente avec expérience en industrie chimique ou pharmaceutique de minimum 5 ans.

• Familiers avec les normes GMP, vous êtes rigoureux et professionnel dans l'application et le suivi des procédures de fabrication.

• Vous adhérez aux directives HSE et les appliquez.

• Ce poste implique des tâches nécessitant une bonne condition physique, notamment la manutention de charges, des déplacements fréquents également dans des escaliers, station debout prolongée.

• Capable de travailler de manière autonome, vous faites preuve d’un esprit d’équipe sain et de motivation.

• Vous utilisez les outils informatiques avec aisance

Notre offre

Nous offrons un travail intéressant et stimulant dans une entreprise innovante et orientée vers la croissance, qui garantit la polyvalence et la diversité. Vous ferez partie d'un environnement collégial et aurez la possibilité de vous épanouir professionnellement dans le cadre d'un emploi à durée indéterminée. De bonnes conditions d'emploi vous attendent, y compris des prestations annexes et sociales attrayantes.

Afin de renforcer notre équipe Production, nous recherchons un  Technologue en Production Chimique et Pharmaceutique (CFC) (a), 100%  pour notre site de Production de Vionnaz (Valais/Wallis, Suisse).

Vos missions principales

• Connaître et suivre les procédures et directives HSE en vigueur pour garantir la sécurité des opérations et le respect de l’environnement.

• Contribuer à la fabrication d’un produit pharmaceutique, depuis la commande des matières premières jusqu’au conditionnement du produit fini.

• Réaliser les opérations de chargement des réacteurs au sein des installations industrielles.

• Effectuer les activités annexes de production : échantillonnage, étiquetage, nettoyage des installations et bâtiments, maintien de l’ordre selon les principes du 5S.

• Détecter et signaler toute déviation éventuelle.

• Participer activement à l’amélioration continue des processus.

• Travailler en équipes (3x8) du dimanche soir au vendredi soir

Votre profil

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un CFC de technologue en production chimique et pharmaceutique, ou d'une formation jugée équivalente avec expérience en industrie chimique ou pharmaceutique de minimum 5 ans.

• Familiers avec les normes GMP, vous êtes rigoureux et professionnel dans l'application et le suivi des procédures de fabrication.

• Vous adhérez aux directives HSE et les appliquez.

• Ce poste implique des tâches nécessitant une bonne condition physique, notamment la manutention de charges, des déplacements fréquents également dans des escaliers, station debout prolongée.

• Capable de travailler de manière autonome, vous faites preuve d’un esprit d’équipe sain et de motivation.

jobs.title: Manager QA (a) - Engineering 100%
jobs.description:
Als QA Manager (a) im Bereich Quality Engineering übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle: Sie stellen die GMP-Compliance unserer Produktions- und Analysesysteme sowie Infrastrukturanlagen sicher und tragen damit entscheidend zur Qualität und zum Wachstum der Bachem Gruppe bei.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Verantwortung für den GMP-konformen Life-Cycle von Produktions- und Analysesystemen sowie Infrastrukturanlagen

• Genehmigung und Bewertung von Requalifizierungen, Instandhaltungsaktivitäten, technischen Änderungsanträgen und Abweichungen

• Fachliche Leitung von Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsaktivitäten in Projekten (inkl. CAPEX)

• Prüfung und Freigabe von Qualifizierungsdokumenten (URS, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ) sowie übergeordneten Validierungsdokumenten

• Erstellung und Genehmigung von GMP-relevanten Dokumenten (SOPs, Logbücher)

• Unterstützung bei Behördeninspektionen und Kundenaudits

• Sicherstellung des GMP-Status von Equipment und Anlagen durch regelmäßige Reviews

Ihr Profil

• Hochschulabschluss (Master) in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Chemie, Verfahrenstechnik, Pharmazie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im cGMP-regulierten Umfeld mit Schwerpunkt Qualifizierung/Validierung (QA, C&Q, Engineering)

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Facility- und Equipment-Qualifizierung

• Strukturierte, präzise und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch

• Wünschenswert: Erfahrung in Reinigungsvalidierung und/oder Computer System Validation sowie Umgang mit SAP oder MasterControl

Was wir bieten

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Expertenrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf Qualität und Compliance

• Mitarbeit an strategischen Projekten in einem innovativen, global wachsenden Unternehmen

• Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und attraktive Sozialleistungen

• Vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

• Mitarbeiterförderung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Zugang zur Vorteilsplattform Swibeco mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

• Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

• Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

Möchten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Innovationen vorantreiben?

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Bewerbungsportal.

Erfahren Sie mehr über die Bachem Gruppe und lassen Sie sich von unserem inspirierenden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Bubendorf begeistern!

jobs.title: QA Engineering Manager (a), 100%
jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n QA Engineering Manager (a), 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Unter Berücksichtigung des Lebenszyklus bestehender Anlagen: Aufrechterhaltung des GMP-Status und Kontrolle von Requalifizierungs- und Instandhaltungsaktivitäten inkl. Change Control-/ und Abweichungs- Prozedere

• Teilnahme an (projektspezifischen) Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsaktivitäten

• Erstellung, Prüfung und Genehmigung von übergeordneten Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsdokumenten

• Erstellung, Prüfung und Genehmigung weiterer, GMP-relevanter Dokumentation (bspw. SOPs, Logbücher)

• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung, Betreuung und Nachbereitung von Behördeninspektionen oder internen Kundenaudits

• Analysieren bestehender Prozesse, Identifizieren von Optimierungspotenzialen und Begleiten der Umsetzung von Verbesserungen

Ihr Profil:

Sie leben Teamgeist, Selbstständigkeit sowie Verantwortungsbewusstsein und zeichnen sich durch ein sehr gutes Qualitätsverständnis aus. Zusätzlich überzeugen Sie uns mit folgenden Punkten:

• Hochschule mit Abschluss Master (in Ingenieurswissenschaften, Chemie, Verfahrenstechnik, Pharmazie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung) oder mit ausgewiesener, mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Fachbereich

• Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im cGMP-regulierten Umfeld

• Mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Quality Assurance (QA)

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Commissioning & Qualification

• Sehr gute GMP-Kenntnisse, insbesondere GMP-Regeln der Schweiz, EU und USA

• Strukturierte, zuverlässige und exakte Arbeitsweise

• Lösungsorientierte, belastbare und kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsmentalität

• Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch ist Voraussetzung, fundierte Englischkenntnisse (C1)

• Spezifische Berufserfahrung und fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Reinigungsvalidierung und/oder Computer System Validation (CSV)

• Sicherheit im Umgang mit Prozess- und Dokumentenmanagementsoftware wie SAP, Master Control oder vergleichbaren Qualitätsmanagementsystemen

• Wir suchen erfahrene Expert:innen, die ihre Kompetenz einbringen und weiterentwickeln wollen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un responsabile tecnico QA dedicato (f/m/d), al 100%. I vostri compiti: Prendere in considerazione il ciclo di vita dei sistemi esistenti: Mantenere lo stato GMP e controllare le attività di riqualificazione e manutenzione, compreso il controllo delle modifiche e le procedure di deviazione Partecipazione ad attività di qualificazione e convalida (specifiche del progetto) Creazione, test e approvazione di documenti di qualificazione e convalida di livello superiore Creazione, test e approvazione di ulteriore documentazione rilevante per le GMP (ad esempio SOP, registri) Supporto nella preparazione, supporto e follow-up delle ispezioni delle autorità o degli audit interni dei clienti Analisi dei processi esistenti, identificazione del potenziale per ottimizzazione e sostegno all'implementazione dei miglioramenti Il tuo profilo: incarni spirito di squadra, indipendenza e senso di responsabilità e sei caratterizzato da un'ottima comprensione della qualità. Inoltre ci convincerete con i seguenti punti: Università con un master (in ingegneria, chimica, ingegneria di processo, farmacia o settore comparabile) o con comprovata esperienza pluriennale nel settore specialistico Esperienza professionale pluriennale in un ambiente regolamentato da cGMP Esperienza consolidata pluriennale nel settore della garanzia della qualità (QA) Ottima conoscenza nel campo della messa in servizio e della qualificazione Ottima conoscenza delle GMP, in particolare delle norme GMP di Svizzera, UE e USA Modo di lavorare strutturato, affidabile e preciso Orientamento alla soluzione, personalità resiliente e comunicativa con una forte mentalità di servizio Ottima espressione orale e scritta in tedesco è un prerequisito, buona conoscenza dell'inglese (C1) Esperienza professionale specifica e solide conoscenze nel campo della validazione delle pulizie e/o della validazione dei sistemi informatici (CSV) Sicurezza nell'utilizzo di software di gestione dei processi e dei documenti come SAP, Master Control o sistemi di gestione della qualità comparabili
• Cerchiamo esperti esperti che vogliano contribuire e sviluppare ulteriormente le loro competenze La nostra offerta: Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno Flessibile Organizzazione dell'orario di lavoro e possibilità di prendere giorni di ferie aggiuntivi con carico di lavoro ridotto Promozione dei dipendenti attraverso numerose offerte di formazione interne ed esterne Accesso alla piattaforma vantaggi Swibeco con sconti da partner esterni Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante per il personale Volete promuovere insieme a noi le innovazioni? Abbiamo suscitato il tuo interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i documenti di candidatura completi tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e lasciati ispirare dal nostro stimolante ambiente di lavoro nella nostra sede di Bubendorf! Nota: non verranno prese in considerazione le candidature provenienti da agenzie di reclutamento. Inoltrare l'annuncio di lavoro tramite e-mail
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicated QA Engineering Manager (f/m/d), 100%.

descriptionByLocale.en: In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. For our QC Late Phase department, we are currently looking for a dedicated Lab Technician QC with a focus on HPLC (f/m/d) for independent and precise analytical work in a specialized team. We currently have a permanent vacancy that offers exciting insights into the late phase of quality control. Their tasks: • Analytical activities: Self-conducting HPLC/U(H)PLC analyses in the context of release, stability and development projects. Professional preparation, operation and maintenance of the equipment, if necessary incl. Troubleshooting to ensure reliable results. • Documentation & Evaluation: Careful documentation of all work steps as well as evaluation of raw data in compliance with relevant quality standards (GMP). • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensuring that all laboratory activities comply with quality specifications and safety guidelines. During quality events (OOX cases) support in processing and documentation. • Teamwork: Close cooperation with QA, production and other internal areas for continuous improvement and quality assurance in the laboratory. Good communication and precise working methods to support efficient and smooth work in the team. jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Engineering Services suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n CAD & CAE Engineer (a) (80 -100%). In dieser Position verantworten Sie die Planung und das Engineering von Produktions- und Infrastrukturanlagen, koordinieren die Erstellung von 3D-Modellen und Planungsunterlagen, begleiten Projekte bis zur erfolgreichen Realisierung. Darüber hinaus bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich zum AVEVA Super-User weiterzuentwickeln und langfristig eine zentrale Rolle bei der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Plattformen zu übernehmen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

CAD / CAE Anlagenplanung

• Planung und Erstellung von 3D-Modellen für Produktions-, Chemie- und Pharmaanlagen im Rahmen von Um- und Neubauprojekten

• Erstellung und Pflege von Planungs- und Engineering-Dokumenten wie R&I-Schemata, Isometrien, Stücklisten und Halterungszeichnungen

• Koordination und Integration sämtlicher beteiligter Gewerke, insbesondere Gebäude, Elektro, EMSR, Lüftung und Reinraumtechnik

• Begleitung von Projekten über alle Phasen hinweg, von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme und Realisierung

• Mitarbeit bei der Einführung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von BIM-Methoden und digitalen Planungsprozessen

Perspektivische Entwicklung zum AVEVA Super-User

• Unterstützung bei der Betreuung und Administration der AVEVA-Engineering-Plattformen sowie deren kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung

• Ansprechpartner für Anwender im First- und Second-Level-Support sowie Mitwirkung bei Schulungen und der Einarbeitung neuer Nutzer

• Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Templates, Standards und Datenbanken sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit IT, Engineering und externen Partnern

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung z. B. als Konstrukteur/in der Anlagen- oder Gebäudeplanung oder vergleichbar

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Anlagenplanung, Verfahrens- und/ oder Gebäudetechnik (bevorzugt im chemisch- / pharmazeutischen Umfeld)

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in AVEVA CAD/CAE-Tools, Erfahrung in der Rolle als Key User, CAD-Administrator oder Super-User von Vorteil

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der CAD-Konstruktion (2D/3D)

• Hohe Belastbarkeit und ein Faible für die digitale Planung

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

descriptionByLocale.it:
Al fine di guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati.

Per rafforzare il nostro team in Servizi di Ingegneria, stiamo cercando uno specialista del sistema CAD / CAE dedicato (f/m/d), 80 – 100%.

In questa funzione, si è responsabili di garantire un funzionamento regolare e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri strumenti di autorizzazione AVEVA come utente e amministratore chiave, nonché per la creazione di piani nell'ambito di progetti di conversione o ristrutturazione. Nuova costruzione di impianti di produzione o infrastrutture.

I loro compiti:

AVEVA Super-User / Amministrazione

• Supporto e amministrazione di strumenti di autore AVEVA (ad esempio E3D, Ingegneria Unificata o soluzioni simili)

• Supporto di primo e secondo livello per gli utenti

• Creazione, manutenzione e sviluppo di modelli, standard e database

• Fornitura di formazione e supporto ai nuovi utenti

• Gestione delle interfacce con partner IT, engineering e esterni

CAD/CAE

• Installazione 3D e pianificazione pipeline per complessi impianti chimici e farmaceutici.

• Creazione di ulteriori documenti di progettazione, come schemi R&I, isometriche, liste di parti e disegni di montaggio

• il coordinamento spaziale di tutti i commerci, come edifici, elettrici, EMSR, ventilazione e camera pulita.

• Monitoraggio dell'attuazione degli impianti

• Sostegno all'attuazione di BIM

Il tuo profilo:

• Formazione completa, ad esempio come costruttore nella pianificazione di impianti o costruzioni o paragonabile

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella pianificazione, processo e / o tecnologia di costruzione (preferibilmente nell'ambiente chimico / farmaceutico)

• Conoscenza approfondita degli strumenti CAD/CAE AVEVA, esperienza nel ruolo di utente chiave, amministratore CAD o utente super di vantaggio

• Diversi anni di esperienza nel design CAD (2D/3D)

• Capacità di carico elevata e debolezza della pianificazione digitale

• Conoscenza fluida del tedesco, ottima conoscenza dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the GSCM Data & Applications department, we are looking for a dedicated Project Manager Supply Chain Applications – Cold Chain Monitorning & Visibility (CCMV) (a), 80-100 %

Their tasks:

• Management and operational implementation of a global cold chain monitoring and visibility solution for transport conditions and time out of refrigeration

• Preparation, moderation and follow-up of project workshops, fit-gap/design sessions, training, key-user voting and steering committees

• Ensuring procedural and regulatory requirements in a GMP/GxP relevant environment. Definition, prioritization and tracking of business and system requirements, milestones, risks and decision-making needs

• Close cooperation with internal stakeholders from supply chain, materials management, QA, QE, IT, customer service, procurement and the global Bachem locations as well as with the implementation partners

• Planning and implementation of the global rollout including piloting, change management, communication measures, hypercare, lessons learned and transfer to a sustainable operating model

• Assumption of tasks within the supply chain application team for further applications and topics, representation in the NiceLabel (label management system)

Your profile:

• Completed studies in business administration, supply chain management, industrial engineering, chemistry or a comparable discipline as well as ideally a further education in supply chain management

• Several years of professional experience (minimum 5 years) in project management, supply chain management, logistics, quality or IT applications, preferably in a GMP/GxP regulated environment of the pharmaceutical industry

• Experience in the implementation, validation and further development of digital supply chain, logistics or SAP-based applications

• In-depth understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes along the entire value chain from goods incoming to production and storage to distribution and transport logistics

• Strong project management skills; Certifications such as IPMA, PMI or PRINCE2 are beneficial

• Very good analytical, conceptual and communication skills as well as experience in the addressable preparation of complex professional, technical and regulatory content

• Very good knowledge of German and English as well as secure application of MS Office, data analysis and reporting tools; ideally complemented by knowledge of SAP (MM/WM), system integration and validation-relevant documentation

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further education opportunities

• Flexible working hours with the option of home office and the option to purchase additional holidays with reduced workload

• Company-internal KITA on the Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our elective savings plan

• Access to advantage platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our staff restaurant

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and be inspired by our inspiring working environment at our location in Bubendorf!

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Global Engineering suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Director Project Large CAPEX (a)  100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Gesamtverantwortung für komplexe Gross- und Investitionsprojekte (Capex) über alle Projektphasen hinweg – von der Machbarkeitsstudie bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.

• Leitung und Steuerung von Machbarkeits-, Varianten- und Konzeptstudien inklusive technischer, wirtschaftlicher und regulatorischer Bewertung sowie Entscheidungsaufbereitung für Management-Gremien.

• Auswahl und Steuerung geeigneter Projektabwicklungsmodelle (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) aus Bauherren-/Owner-Sicht.

• Sicherstellung der Produktionsbereitschaft sowie der GMP-, Sicherheits- und Gesetzeskonformität von Anlagen, Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen.

• Konzeption, Planung und Umsetzung von Neu- und Umbauten inklusive Integration von Prozess-, Automatisierungs- und Gebäudethemen.

• Führung interdisziplinärer Projektteams sowie Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister.

• Planung, Überwachung und Durchführung von Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierung neuer Anlagen und Gebäude.

• Budgetverantwortung inkl. Planung, Konsolidierung und Überwachung von Investitions- und Betriebskosten.

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Hochschulstudium (ETH/FH/TU) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Gross- und Investitionsprojekte im industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise GMP-reguliert.

• Fundierte Erfahrung mit Projektabwicklungsmodellen wie EPCm, EPC und AE&CM.

• Erfahrung in frühen Projektphasen (Machbarkeits- und Konzeptstudien) sowie in Governance- und Entscheidungsprozessen.

• Gutes technisches Gesamtverständnis für Prozess-, Automatisierungs- und Gebäudethemen.

• Erfahrung im Budget- und Investitionsmanagement (Capex/Opex).

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeit.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in peptide manufacturing, we are looking for a dedicated Cluster Specialist (a), 100%, on day shift.

Their tasks:

• Coordination of cross-layer tasks in cooperation with shift managers and support of the Production Leader in operational shift planning.

• Support of production shifts during recurring maintenance and control work in the CMMS.

• Cooperation in the preparation, testing and optimization of production documents, MES-MBPRs and PLS recipes (PCS 7).

• Support for process risk analyses, HAZOPs and other safety and quality-relevant assessments.

• Creation, implementation and documentation of plant cleaning including the associated MES-ESP and PLS recipes.

• Participation in the root cause analysis and processing of deviations.

• Ensure up-to-date SOPs and work instructions as well as support in training production staff.

• Function as Subject Matter Expert (SME) and representation of production in technical, operational and process-related issues.

• Support of operational engineers and chemists in the optimization of plants, processes and planning activities.

• Preparation of facilities for maintenance, repairs and revisions including preparation of LOTO plans and coordination of production personnel during plant downtimes.

Your profile:

• Completed training as a chemical or similar technical training.

• At least five years of professional experience in a chemical production plant, ideally as shift manager or long-term deputy shift manager.

• Strong organisational talent as well as a structured and independent working method.

• High safety awareness and experience in dealing with hazardous substances and chemical production processes.

• Ability to assess risks and derive appropriate safety measures.

• Good knowledge of production plants as well as technical understanding in the field of plant construction and process operation.

• Secure understanding of GMP and experience in compliance with regulatory and qualitative requirements.

• Experience with process control systems, preferably PCS 7, and with electronic or paperless production documentation.

• Communication strength and experience in lateral cooperation with various functions.

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing as well as good knowledge of the common MS-Office and EDP applications.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further education opportunities

• Company-internal KITA on the Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our elective savings plan

• Access to advantage platforms with discounts from external partners

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

• Attuazione dei cambiamenti alla Master Batch Records (MBRs) nel MES (PAS-X) in stretta collaborazione con i produttori.

• Ulteriore sviluppo e armonizzazione dei modelli di documento e degli standard per aumentare l'efficienza nella creazione di documenti.

Come chimico e farmacologo/login (CPT per breve), sei lo specialista nei nostri stabilimenti di produzione chimica. Hanno lavorato nella produzione di peptidi, oligonucleotidi e composti organici complessi utilizzati come farmaci. Operano e controllano gli apparecchi di reazione semi-automatizzati, misurando e regolando dispositivi, pompe e valvole. Essi controllano anche gli impianti di produzione in cui le reazioni chimiche e i processi tecnologici avvengono dalle moderne console di controllo. Il lavoro di manutenzione e manutenzione su attrezzature e impianti chimici fa parte del mandato del CPT.

• Interesse tecnico e comprensione

As a chemical and pharmacologist/login (CPT for short), you are the specialist in our chemical production plants. They operate and monitor the semi-automated reaction apparatus, measuring and regulating devices, pumps and valves. The maintenance and maintenance work on equipment and chemical plants is part of the CPT’s remit.

jobs.description:
Die Bachem AG expandiert weiter und investiert in neue Gebäude und Produktionsanlagen zur Herstellung innovativer Produkte. Das Ziel unserer Berufsausbildung ist der nachhaltige und langfristige Aufbau der Fach- und Führungskompetenz im Unternehmen, um das zukünftige Wachstum zu meistern. Jedes Jahr bieten wir eine Lehrstelle zur Logistiker/in EFZ, Fachrichtung Lager (a) an.

Die 3-jährige Ausbildung in der Bachem basiert auf dem Modell der trialen Ausbildung, in welchem an drei Lernorten Theorie, Grundausbildung und Praxis vermittelt werden.

• Den Grossteil der Lehre verbringst du in den zwei Hauptlager für technische und chemische Materialien. Ausserdem besuchst du die Bereiche Tanklager, Entsorgung, Belieferung und Versand. Um den ganzen Prozess der Logistik kenne zu lernen und zu verstehen, gibt es noch 3 kleinere Stagen in den Bereichen Planung, Einkauf und Distribution.

• Während einem Tag pro Woche besuchst du die Gewerbeschule in Liestal. In der Berufskunde werden alle theoretischen Grundlagen gelegt, welche in den Arbeitsabläufen in der Praxis zur Anwendung kommen.

• Neben dieser praktischen und theoretischen Ausbildung absolvieren die Auszubildenden die überbetrieblichen Kurse der SVBL   ( Schweizerische Vereinigung für die Berufsbildung in der Logistik)  und erlangen unter anderem den Staplerfahrausweis.

Berufsbeschreibung:

Das Lager ist die Schaltzentrale unserer Firma. Hier koordinieren Logistiker alle Materialflüsse der unterschiedlichsten Abteilungen im Unternehmen. Angelieferte Waren werden abgeladen, kontrolliert und mittels EDV im System verbucht. Logistiker kommissionieren Waren aufgrund von Kundenbestellungen und stellen den Transport der Güter an ihren Bestimmungsort sicher. Waren werden fachgerecht verpackt, und mit Hilfe moderner Stapler und Flurförderzeuge, nach Vorschriften verladen und gesichert. Sie führen die Kontrolle der Lagerbestände durch und setzten die Anforderungen an einen reibungslosen Güterfluss optimal um. Ein weiteres Aufgabengebiet ist die fachgerechte Entsorgung von Reststoffen und Abfällen, unter Einhaltung aller umweltrechtlichen und gesetzlichen Vorschriften.

Die Logistiker stellen im Team den Warenfluss unter Verwendung moderner Hilfsmittel sicher. Genauso wie sie die Materialflüsse koordinieren sind sie auch die Ansprechpartner für die anderen an den Warenflüssen beteiligten Abteilungen.

Anforderungen:

• Niveau A oder E der Sekundarschule Baselland (oder Gleichwertiges)

• Gute Leistungen in den Kernfächer Deutsch und Mathematik

• Teamfähigkeit und offen Neues zu Lernen

• Freude und Interesse an Zahlen und Sprachen

• Flair und Interesse für die tägliche Arbeit am PC

• Körperliche Aktivitäten sehen Sie als willkommenen Teil Ihres Arbeitsalltags

Bachem Benefits für Lernende:

• Dein Monatslohn: 1. Lehrjahr: CHF 800.00 / 2. Lehrjahr: CHF 1,000.00 /
3. Lehrjahr: CHF 1,300.00 (jeweils x 12)

• 30 Ferientage für alle Lernende

• Einmaliger Beitrag an den persönlichen Laptop

• Monatlicher Beitrag an das U-Abo

• Und viele weitere Benefits

Du interessierst dich für unsere Lehrstelle und willst Teil von Bachem werden? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Online-Bewerbung über unser Recruiting-Tool mit folgenden Unterlagen:

• Zeugnisse der letzten drei Schuljahre (Sekundarschule)

• Tabellarischer Lebenslauf

• Motivationsschreiben

Deine berufliche Grundausbildung bei Bachem ist nachhaltig, praxisorientiert und die beste Vorbereitung für das zukünftige Berufsleben.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bachem AG continua ad espandersi e investire in nuovi edifici e impianti produttivi per la produzione di prodotti innovativi. L'obiettivo della nostra formazione professionale è lo sviluppo sostenibile e a lungo termine delle competenze specialistiche e di leadership nell'azienda al fine di padroneggiare la crescita futura. Ogni anno offriamo un apprendistato allo specialista della logistica, magazzino di specializzazione (a).

La formazione di 3 anni a Bachem si basa sul modello di formazione di prova, in cui la teoria, la formazione di base e la pratica sono insegnate in tre luoghi di apprendimento.

• La maggior parte dell'insegnamento è spesa nei due campi principali per materiali tecnici e chimici. Inoltre, si visitano le aree di stoccaggio serbatoio, smaltimento, consegna e spedizione. Per conoscere e comprendere l'intero processo di logistica, ci sono ancora 3 fasi più piccole nei settori della pianificazione, dell'acquisto e della distribuzione.

• Durante un giorno alla settimana si visita la scuola di affari a Liestal. Negli studi professionali vengono poste tutte le basi teoriche, che vengono utilizzate nei processi di lavoro in pratica.

• Oltre a questa formazione pratica e teorica, i tirocinanti completano i corsi intercompany della SVBL (Associazione svizzera per la formazione professionale nella logistica) e ottengono, tra l'altro, la patente di guida per camion.

Descrizione professionale:

Il magazzino è il centro di controllo della nostra azienda. Qui, gli esperti di logistica coordinano tutti i flussi materiali da una vasta gamma di dipartimenti in azienda. Le merci consegnate sono scaricate, controllate e registrate nel sistema dal computer. Gli operatori logistici scelgono merci in base agli ordini del cliente e assicurano il trasporto di merci alla loro destinazione. Le merci sono imballate professionalmente, e con l'aiuto di moderni carrelli elevatori e camion industriali, caricati e protetti secondo le normative. Essi effettuano il controllo delle scorte e implementano in modo ottimale i requisiti per un flusso regolare di merci. Un altro settore di responsabilità è lo smaltimento professionale di materiali e rifiuti residui, nel rispetto di tutte le normative ambientali e legali.

Il team logistico garantisce il flusso di merci utilizzando strumenti moderni. Come coordinano i flussi materiali, sono anche i punti di contatto per gli altri dipartimenti coinvolti nei flussi di merci.

Requisiti

• Livello A o E della scuola secondaria Baselland (o equivalente)

• Buona prestazione nei principali soggetti tedesco e matematico

• Lavoro di squadra e apprendimento aperto

• Gioia e interesse nei numeri e nelle lingue

• Flair e interesse per il lavoro quotidiano sul PC

• Attività fisiche vi vedono come una parte di benvenuto della vostra giornata di lavoro

Bachem Vantaggi per gli studenti:

• Il tuo stipendio mensile: 1° anno di apprendistato: CHF 800.00 / 2. Anno di formazione: CHF 1.000.00 /
3. Maestro
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bachem AG continues to expand and invests in new buildings and production facilities for the production of innovative products. The goal of our vocational training is the sustainable and long-term development of specialist and leadership skills in the company in order to master future growth. Every year we offer an apprenticeship to the logistics specialist, specialization warehouse (a).

The 3-year training in Bachem is based on the model of trial training, in which theory, basic training and practice are taught at three learning locations.

• Most of the teaching is spent in the two main camps for technical and chemical materials. In addition, you visit the areas of tank storage, disposal, delivery and shipping. In order to get to know and understand the whole process of logistics, there are still 3 smaller stages in the areas of planning, purchasing and distribution.

• During one day a week you visit the business school in Liestal. In vocational studies, all theoretical foundations are laid, which are used in the work processes in practice.

• In addition to this practical and theoretical training, the trainees complete the intercompany courses of the SVBL (Swiss Association for Vocational Training in Logistics) and obtain, among other things, the truck driving licence.

Professional description:

The warehouse is the control center of our company. Here, logistics experts coordinate all material flows from a wide range of departments in the company. Delivered goods are unloaded, checked and recorded in the system by computer. Logistics operators pick goods based on customer orders and ensure the transport of goods to their destination. Goods are packed professionally, and with the help of modern forklifts and industrial trucks, loaded and secured according to regulations. They carry out the control of the stockpiles and optimally implement the requirements for a smooth flow of goods. Another area of responsibility is the professional disposal of residual materials and waste, in compliance with all environmental and legal regulations.

The logistics team ensures the flow of goods using modern tools. Just as they coordinate the material flows, they are also the contact points for the other departments involved in the goods flows.

Requirements

• Level A or E of the secondary school Baselland (or equivalent)

• Good performance in the core subjects German and Mathematics

• Teamwork and open learning

• Joy and interest in numbers and languages

• Flair and interest in daily work on the PC

• Physical activities see you as a welcome part of your workday

• Your monthly salary: 1st year of apprenticeship: CHF 800.00 / 2. Year of training: CHF 1,000.00 /
