jobs.description:
Bist Du kurz vor Lehrstellensuche und interessiert an einem Schuppertag als Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie?
 Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Berufsbeschreibung
 Der Beruf Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie wird in zwei Fachbereiche eingeteilt:

Synthese

Aus zwei oder mehreren Ausgangsstoffen stellst Du, bei uns in der Bachem AG, eine Vielfalt an neuen Peptiden, Aminosäurederivaten und anderen organischen Substanzen und Verbindungen her. Laboranten berechnen die Mengen der einzusetzenden Ausgangsstoffe und lassen sie miteinander reagieren. Aus dem Reaktionsgemisch isolieren sie das gewünschte Produkt und reinigen anschliessend das erhaltene Rohprodukt. Die so hergestellten Substanzen werden von ihnen auf Menge, Qualität und Zusammensetzung analysiert. Im Lehrgang mit Schwerpunkt Synthese wird ein besonderer Wert auf die Herstellung von Substanzen gelegt.

Laboranten arbeiten im Team unter Verwendung einer Vielfalt von Glasapparaturen und computerunterstützten Geräten. Alle Arbeitsschritte und Reaktionsabläufe werden genau beobachtet und protokolliert, damit die Arbeiten zur fortlaufenden Prozessverbesserung beitragen.

Analytik

Laboranten mit Schwerpunkt Analytik sind hauptsächlich in der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) tätig. Dabei begleiten sie den gesamten Warenfluss durch die Firma. In der Eingangskontrolle werden die Rohmaterialien auf ihre Identität, ihre Reinheit und andere Kriterien überprüft. Im Verlauf einer Synthese werden für die produzierenden Bereiche ergänzende Analysen mit verschiedensten Methoden durchgeführt. Ist ein Produkt fertig gestellt, wird es von der QC einer detaillierten Endanalyse (Schlusskontrolle) unterzogen, bei der alle zum Voraus definierten Qualitätsanforderungen überprüft werden. Bei diesen Analysen wird eine Vielzahl an Resultaten generiert, welche die Laboranten anschliessend auswerten, verarbeiten, umrechnen und vergleichen. Der Umgang mit kleinen Probenmengen, das Arbeiten mit zum Teil hochkomplexen, computergesteuerten Geräten , sowie das Auswerten von Resultaten mit hochspezifischer Software gehören zum Alltag.

Dein Profil

• Interesse an naturwissenschaftlichen Prozessen

• Logisches und vernetztes Denken

• Eine gute Beobachtungsgabe sowie ein exaktes und sauberes Arbeiten

• Teamfähig, zuverlässige, flexible Persönlichkeit

• Ausdauer und körperliche Belastbarkeit

Ablauf

Sei poco prima di cercare un apprendistato e interessato a uno Schuppertag come assistente di laboratorio / nel campo della chimica?
Allora hai proprio ragione con noi!

Descrizione professionale
La professione di tecnico/chimica di laboratorio è divisa in due discipline:

Sintesi

Da due o più materiali di partenza, si producono una varietà di nuovi peptidi, derivati di amminoacidi e altre sostanze e composti organici. I laboratori calcolano gli importi dei materiali di partenza da utilizzare e permettono loro di reagire tra loro. Essi isolano il prodotto desiderato dalla miscela di reazione e successivamente purificano il prodotto grezzo ottenuto. Le sostanze così preparate sono analizzate da loro per quantità, qualità e composizione. Nel corso con particolare attenzione alla sintesi, si pone particolare enfasi sulla produzione di sostanze.

I tecnici di laboratorio lavorano in un team utilizzando una varietà di apparecchi di vetro e dispositivi assistiti da computer. Tutte le fasi di lavoro e le sequenze di reazione sono strettamente monitorate e registrate in modo che il lavoro contribuisca al miglioramento continuo del processo.

Analisi

I tecnici di laboratorio con un focus sull'analisi sono principalmente coinvolti nel controllo della qualità (QC). Essi accompagnano l'intero flusso di merci attraverso l'azienda. Il controllo delle entrate controlla le materie prime per la loro identità, purezza e altri criteri. Nel corso di una sintesi, vengono effettuate analisi complementari utilizzando una vasta gamma di metodi per le aree di produzione. Una volta completato un prodotto, viene sottoposto a un'analisi finale dettagliata (ispezione finale) dal QC, in cui vengono verificati tutti i requisiti di qualità definiti in anticipo. In queste analisi vengono generati un gran numero di risultati, che gli operatori di laboratorio valutano, elaborano, convertono e confrontano. La gestione di piccole quantità di campione, lavorando con dispositivi a volte altamente complessi, controllati dal computer e la valutazione dei risultati con software altamente specifico fanno parte della vita quotidiana.

Il tuo profilo

• Interessi nei processi scientifici

• pensiero logico e in rete

• Buone capacità di osservazione e lavoro preciso e pulito

• Personalità capace, affidabile, flessibile

• Resistenza e resistenza fisica

Data di scadenza

Vi mostriamo in questo giorno quanto sia eccitante e variata questa professione. Sarete portati dai tirocinanti ai loro posti di linea e può fare tutte le vostre domande direttamente. La giornata inizia con l'intuizione della sintesi e dopo un pranzo congiunto continua nell'analisi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you shortly before looking for an apprenticeship and interested in a Schuppertag as a laboratory assistant / in the field of chemistry?
Then you are exactly right with us!

Professional description
The profession of laboratory technician/chemistry is divided into two disciplines:

Synthesis

From two or more starting materials, you produce a variety of new peptides, amino acid derivatives and other organic substances and compounds. Laborators calculate the amounts of starting materials to be used and allow them to react with each other. They isolate the desired product from the reaction mixture and subsequently purify the crude product obtained. The substances thus prepared are analyzed by them for quantity, quality and composition. In the course with a focus on synthesis, special emphasis is placed on the production of substances.

Laboratory technicians work in a team using a variety of glass apparatus and computer-assisted devices. All work steps and reaction sequences are closely monitored and recorded so that the work contributes to continuous process improvement.

Analysis

Laboratory technicians with a focus on analytics are mainly involved in quality control (QC). They accompany the entire flow of goods through the company. The entry control checks the raw materials for their identity, purity and other criteria. In the course of a synthesis, supplementary analyses are carried out using a wide variety of methods for the production areas. Once a product has been completed, it is subjected to a detailed final analysis (final inspection) by the QC, in which all quality requirements defined in advance are checked. In these analyses, a large number of results are generated, which the laboratory operators subsequently evaluate, process, convert and compare. Handling small sample quantities, working with sometimes highly complex, computer-controlled devices and evaluating results with highly specific software are part of everyday life.

Your profile

• Interest in Scientific Processes

• Logical and networked thinking

• Good observation skills as well as precise and clean work

• Team capable, reliable, flexible personality

• Endurance and physical resilience

Expiry date

We show you on this day how exciting and varied this profession is. You will be taken by the trainees to their line places and can ask all your questions directly. The day starts with the insight into the synthesis and after a joint lunch it continues in the analysis.

• Current certificate

Berufsbeschreibung
Der Beruf Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie wird in zwei Fachbereiche eingeteilt:

Synthese

Aus zwei oder mehreren Ausgangsstoffen stellst Du, bei uns in der Bachem AG, eine Vielfalt an neuen Peptiden, Aminosäurederivaten und anderen organischen Substanzen und Verbindungen her. Laboranten berechnen die Mengen der einzusetzenden Ausgangsstoffe und lassen sie miteinander reagieren. Aus dem Reaktionsgemisch isolieren sie das gewünschte Produkt und reinigen anschliessend das erhaltene Rohprodukt. Die so hergestellten Substanzen werden von ihnen auf Menge, Qualität und Zusammensetzung analysiert. Im Lehrgang mit Schwerpunkt Synthese wird ein besonderer Wert auf die Herstellung von Substanzen gelegt.

Laboranten arbeiten im Team unter Verwendung einer Vielfalt von Glasapparaturen und computerunterstützten Geräten. Alle Arbeitsschritte und Reaktionsabläufe werden genau beobachtet und protokolliert, damit die Arbeiten zur fortlaufenden Prozessverbesserung beitragen.

Analytik

Laboranten mit Schwerpunkt Analytik sind hauptsächlich in der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) tätig. Dabei begleiten sie den gesamten Warenfluss durch die Firma. In der Eingangskontrolle werden die Rohmaterialien auf ihre Identität, ihre Reinheit und andere Kriterien überprüft. Im Verlauf einer Synthese werden für die produzierenden Bereiche ergänzende Analysen mit verschiedensten Methoden durchgeführt. Ist ein Produkt fertig gestellt, wird es von der QC einer detaillierten Endanalyse (Schlusskontrolle) unterzogen, bei der alle zum Voraus definierten Qualitätsanforderungen überprüft werden. Bei diesen Analysen wird eine Vielzahl an Resultaten generiert, welche die Laboranten anschliessend auswerten, verarbeiten, umrechnen und vergleichen. Der Umgang mit kleinen Probenmengen, das Arbeiten mit zum Teil hochkomplexen, computergesteuerten Geräten , sowie das Auswerten von Resultaten mit hochspezifischer Software gehören zum Alltag.

Bei Bachem wirst du nicht nur ausgebildet, sondern wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in einer hochmodernen Industrie hinein.

Die Bachem AG wächst weiter und investiert in neue Gebäude sowie moderne Produktionsanlagen zur Herstellung innovativer Produkte. Mit unserer Berufsausbildung verfolgen wir das Ziel, Fach- und Führungskompetenzen nachhaltig aufzubauen, um unser zukünftiges Wachstum erfolgreich zu gestalten.

Wir bieten jährlich neun Lehrstellen als Laborantin / Laborant EFZ Fachrichtung Chemie mit Schwerpunkt Synthese oder Analytik (a) an.

Ausbildungskonzept

Die dreijährige Ausbildung basiert auf dem bewährten trialen Modell mit drei Lernorten:

• Berufsfachschule (aprentas, Muttenz)

• Internes Lehrlabor bei Bachem

Laborantinnen und Laboranten EFZ Fachrichtung Chemie sind Expertinnen und Experten im Labor. Sie arbeiten mit unterschiedlichsten Stoffen, die sie untersuchen, aufbereiten oder selbst herstellen.

Im Syntheselabor entwickeln sie neue Moleküle. Aus verschiedenen Ausgangsstoffen entstehen durch gezielte chemische Prozesse neue Verbindungen, Präzision und fundiertes chemisches Verständnis sind dabei entscheidend.

Im Analyselabor prüfen sie Proben auf Identität und Reinheit. Mithilfe moderner Analysegeräte und Methoden stellen sie sicher, dass alle Produkte höchsten Qualitätsanforderungen entsprechen.

Immaginate di lavorare su farmaci che aiutano le persone in tutto il mondo e di essere parte di un team che rende possibili medicine moderne.

A Bachem, non solo sarete addestrati, ma anche crescere passo dopo passo in un ruolo responsabile in un'industria all'avanguardia.

Bachem AG continua a crescere e investire in nuovi edifici e moderni impianti produttivi per la produzione di prodotti innovativi. Con la nostra formazione professionale, perseguiamo l'obiettivo di costruire in modo sostenibile competenze specialistiche e di leadership al fine di plasmare la nostra crescita futura con successo.

Ogni anno offriamo nove apprendisti come assistente di laboratorio / assistente di laboratorio EFZ specializzazione in chimica con un focus sulla sintesi o l'analisi (a).

Concetto di formazione

La formazione triennale si basa sul modello di prova collaudato con tre sedi di apprendimento:

• Scuola Professionale (aprentas, Muttenz)

• Laboratorio di insegnamento interno a Bachem

• Pratica in varie aree di Bachem AG

Profilo professionale

I tecnici del laboratorio EFZ Dipartimento di Chimica sono esperti in laboratorio. Lavorano con una vasta gamma di sostanze, che esaminano, elaborano o producono se stessi.

Nel laboratorio di sintesi, sviluppano nuove molecole. Diversi materiali di partenza danno origine a nuovi composti attraverso processi chimici mirati, precisione e comprensione chimica sonora sono cruciali.

Nel laboratorio analitico, testano campioni per identità e purezza. Utilizzando moderne attrezzature di analisi e metodi, assicurano che tutti i prodotti soddisfano i più elevati requisiti di qualità.

• Livello della scuola secondaria E o P (Basselland) o istruzione equivalente

Imagine working on drugs that help people worldwide and being part of a team that makes modern medicines possible.

At Bachem, you will not only be trained, but also grow step by step into a responsible role in a state-of-the-art industry.

Bachem AG continues to grow and invests in new buildings and modern production facilities for the production of innovative products. With our vocational training, we pursue the goal of sustainably building up specialist and leadership skills in order to shape our future growth successfully.

Every year we offer nine apprenticeships as laboratory assistant / laboratory assistant EFZ specialisation in chemistry with a focus on synthesis or analysis (a).

• Internal teaching laboratory at Bachem

• Practice in various areas of Bachem AG

Professional profile

Laboratory technicians EFZ Department of Chemistry are experts in the laboratory. They work with a wide variety of substances, which they examine, process or produce themselves.

In the synthesis laboratory, they develop new molecules. Different starting materials give rise to new compounds through targeted chemical processes, precision and sound chemical understanding are crucial.

In the analytical laboratory, they test samples for identity and purity. Using modern analysis equipment and methods, they ensure that all products meet the highest quality requirements.

Requirements

• Secondary school level E or P (Baselland) or equivalent education

• Interest in scientific contexts

• Logical and networked thinking

• Good observation skills as well as precise and careful working methods

• Reliability and endurance

• Teamwork and flexibility

Benefits for learners

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unserer Wirkstoff-Produktionsabteilung suchen wir eine/n motivierte/n Chemie- und Pharmatechnologen/Chemikanten (w/m/d).

In unserem Produktionsbetrieb stellen Sie pharmazeutisch wirksame Oligonukleotide und verwandte Substanzen her. Dabei arbeiten Sie unter GMP-Bedingungen und setzen von der Herstellung bis zur Aufreinigung moderne Produktionsanlagen ein. Über die praxisorientierte Einarbeitung werden Sie die notwendige Sicherheit gewinnen, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich an unseren Produktionsanlagen zu arbeiten und ein Teil unseres Teams werden. Wenn es Ihnen darüber hinaus wichtig ist, über die tägliche Arbeit hinaus mit uns an der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsabläufe zu arbeiten und die Möglichkeit schätzen, auf diese Weise Ihre Arbeitsbedingungen mitzugestalten, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sie steuern, überwachen und beobachten unsere Herstellungsprozesse und dokumentieren GMP-gerecht.

• Sie kontrollieren die Chargen-Dokumentation.

• Sie helfen bei der Qualifizierung des Produktionsequipments.

• Sie bereiten In-Prozess-Kontrollen und Musterzüge vor und führen diese selbst durch.

• Sie treffen zusammen mit den verantwortlichen Gruppenleitern z.B. anhand von In-Prozess-Kontrollen Entscheide für den weiteren Produktionsverlauf.

• Sie führen Reinigungs- und Wartungsarbeiten sowie einfache Instandsetzungstätigkeiten an den Produktionsanlagen aus.

• Sie bereiten Herstellungskampagnen vor. Dafür stellen Sie Ausrüstung, Lösungsmittel und Ausgangsstoffe in den jeweiligen Produktionsräumen bereit und kontrollieren die Apparate und Anlagen.

• Sie arbeiten aktiv und selbstständig an der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsabläufe mit.

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Chemielaborant oder einer gleichwertigen Ausbildung bzw. Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe

• Bereitschaft für Schichtarbeit (Früh- und Spätschicht) Kein 6/4 -oder Nachtschichtmodell

• Vorliebe zur Arbeit und Dokumentation nach GMP-Vorgaben sowie Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld von Vorteil

• Erfahrung mit Tätigkeiten im Reinraum sind erwünscht

• Ausgeprägte Zuverlässigkeit und Selbstständigkeit

• Eine strukturierte und saubere und selbständige Arbeitsweise, die es Ihnen erlaubt, jederzeit den Überblick zu behalten

• Flexibilität, Kommunikation und Lernbereitschaft gehören zu Ihren Stärken

• Sie zeichnen sich durch ein hohes Mass an Zuverlässigkeit, Selbständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit aus

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Kenntnisse in der org. Synthese und chromatographischen Aufreinigung, sowie gängigen Analysentechniken wie HPLC/UPLC sind von Vorteil.

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

• Mitarbeiterförderung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Zugang zur Vorteilsplattform Swibeco mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

• Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant

• Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

Möchten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Innovationen vorantreiben?

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Bewerbungsportal.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our drug production department, we are looking for a motivated chemical and pharmaceutical technologist/chemical (m/f/d).

In our production plant, you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production facilities from production to cleaning. Through practical training, you will gain the necessary security to work independently and independently on our production facilities and become part of our team. If it is also important for you to work with us on the continuous improvement of our production facilities and work processes and appreciate the opportunity to help shape your working conditions, then you are at the right place.

Their tasks:

• They control, monitor and observe our production processes and document GMP-compliant.

• They control the batch documentation.

• They help to qualify the production equipment.

• They prepare in-process controls and sample trains and carry them out themselves.

• Together with the responsible group leaders, they make decisions for the further course of production on the basis of in-process controls, for example.

• They carry out cleaning and maintenance as well as simple repair work on the production facilities.

• They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. For this purpose, you provide equipment, solvents and starting materials in the respective production rooms and control the apparatus and plants.

• You are actively and independently involved in the continuous improvement of our production facilities and work processes.

Your profile:

• Completed training as a chemical, chemical laboratory or equivalent; or Chemical and pharmaceutical technologists

• Readiness for shift work (early and late shift) No 6/4 or night shift model

• Preference to work and documentation according to GMP specifications as well as experience in the GMP environment is advantageous

• Experience with activities in the clean room is desired

• Strong reliability and independence

• A structured and clean and independent way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times

• Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths

• They are characterized by a high degree of reliability, independence and teamwork ability

• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing

• Knowledge in organic synthesis and chromatographic purification, as well as common analytical techniques such as HPLC/UPLC are advantageous.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working time arrangements and option to receive additional holidays with reduced workload

• Employee support through numerous internal and external training offers

• 60% takeover of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory provision with our elective savings plan

• Access to the advantage platform Swibeco with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our staff restaurant

• Various free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Do you want to drive innovation together with us?

Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Lead (f/m/d), 100%.

In this role, you are responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and oversight of commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for GMP ‑ regulated pharmaceutical facilities. Furthermore, this role ensures that all systems, equipment, and utilities are delivered in full compliance with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and project timelines. Acting as a technical and regulatory leader, the position interfaces closely with Engineering, Quality, Automation, Operations, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Your tasks:

• Lead and manage commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems

• Develop and implement C&Q strategies, C&Q Master Plans, and risk ‑ based qualification approaches

• Author, review, and approve GMP documentation including URS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and reports

• Ensure compliance with GMP regulations and internal quality standards

• Act as the primary C&Q interface to Quality Assurance and support regulatory inspections and audits

• Coordinate cross ‑ functional stakeholders and manage external vendors and CQV consultants

• Monitor progress, manage risks, deviations, and change controls, and provide transparent reporting to project leadership

• Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practices across C&Q activities

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline

• Extensive experience in Commissioning & Qualification / Validation within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of leading C&Q activities on large scale GMP capital projects

• Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (EU/FDA), ISPE guidelines, and risk based qualification methodologies

• Experience with facilities and utilities (e.g. HVAC, media systems); automation and CSV experience is an advantage

• Excellent written and spoken German and English

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of our long-term strategy to expand production capacity. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a Master Data Management & Governance Specialist (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Own the master data workstream for the new Sisslerfeld manufacturing facility, ensuring readiness throughout commissioning, qualification, validation, and go-live.

• Define and establish SAP master data structures, including materials, BOMs, recipes, routings, batches, equipment/resources, business partners, and procurement data.

• Implement data quality controls, KPIs, scorecards, and remediation processes, supported by training and change management

• Ensure alignment with the company-wide data governance framework, including integration with downstream systems such as MES, LIMS, eQMS, WMS, and the enterprise data platform

• Strong hands-on SAP master data expertise, particularly material master, business partner, BOMs, routings, and recipes

• Experience with SAP MDG or comparable MDM platforms such as Informatica MDM, Stibo, or Reltio

• Good understanding of GMP, ALCOA+ data integrity principles, audit requirements, and regulated manufacturing environments

• Proven experience establishing data governance frameworks, ownership models, and stewardship processes, ideally in a greenfield or transformation environment

• Strong program delivery and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align and build consensus across multiple functions

• Experience with SAP S/4HANA and relevant SAP modules such as PP/PI, QM, MM, or EWM is highly desirable

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; SAP/data management certifications, greenfield pharmaceutical experience, and German language skills are advantageous

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

jobs.title: Senior Commissioning & Qualification Engineer Sisslerfeld (a), 100%
jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Engineer (a) , 100% to support our global capital projects and play a key role in the standardization and further development of C&Q processes across our international network. In this role, you will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and management of C&Q activities – from concept to handover – and will contribute your expertise to a wide range of projects worldwide.

Your tasks:

• Leadership of C&Q activities within multidisciplinary large capital projects

• Coordination and management of C&Q‑related deviations and changes within defined timelines and in compliance with required quality standards

• Responsibility for budget, schedule, prioritization, resources, and the quality of C&Q execution

• Analysis of options, planning of execution strategies, and development of detailed C&Q schedules

• Preparation of tender documents, support in procurement processes, and cost estimation

• Ensuring a smooth handover to Operations and Quality

• Risk management, including the derivation of proactive measures in case of deviations

• Management and onboarding of the C&Q team, including external partners

• Responsibility for training C&Q teams and ensuring adherence to internal standards

• Clear, structured, and audience‑appropriate communication with all stakeholders

• Close collaboration with global sites to harmonize C&Q standards and digital processes

• Support in supplier evaluation and coaching of local SMEs

• Active promotion of lean and agile methods within engineering and C&Q contexts

• Technical review activities in CAPEX projects

• Participation in or leadership of international teams in GMP engineering, C&Q, and global initiatives

Your profile:

• Completed degree in engineering, natural sciences, or a related field

• At least 10 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry

• Proven experience in international CAPEX projects (medium to large scale, complex requirements)

• Extensive C&Q expertise in areas such as:

• Biologics/Drug Substance, Drug Product

• Small Molecules

• Packaging, warehousing, GMP & non‑GMP infrastructure

• Automation systems & new technologies

• Strong knowledge of global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISPE Integrated Commissioning & Qualification, etc.)

• Ideally experience with KNEAT Gx

• Deep understanding of project management, PQS/EM compliance, and interfaces with Quality

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills

• Analytical thinking and financial acumen to derive sustainable, efficient solutions

• Willingness to drive change, creative thinking, and the ability to support organizations through transformation

• Confident working style in global, culturally diverse teams

Our offer:

We offer you an exciting and challenging role in a dynamic and rapidly growing environment. This position provides you with the opportunity to make a lasting contribution to the company and the region.

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment!

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of our long-term strategy to expand production capacity. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. For this large-scale CAPEX investment project, we are seeking a Data Engineer.

Your tasks:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines on the Databricks platform using PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake.

• Build and optimize enterprise data architectures, including medallion frameworks (Bronze, Silver, Gold), ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability across all layers.

• Integrate manufacturing and business-critical data sources such as SAP, MES, LIMS, eQMS, and process historians into a unified data ecosystem.

• Develop and manage automated data workflows, orchestration processes, and reusable data products to support analytics, reporting, and operational excellence.

• Implement data governance, security, lineage, and compliance standards, ensuring adherence to GMP, GxP, ALCOA+, and data integrity requirements.

• Monitor and enhance data platform performance through workload optimization, cost management, and adoption of engineering best practices, testing frameworks, and CI/CD processes.

• Collaborate closely with data scientists, process engineers, business stakeholders, QA, and validation teams to translate business needs into production-ready data solutions.

• Enable advanced analytics and machine learning initiatives by providing curated datasets, semantic data models, feature engineering capabilities, and self-service analytics foundations

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data pipelines and data platforms.

• Strong expertise in Databricks technologies, including PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and workflow orchestration.

• Proficient in SQL and Python, with a solid understanding of software engineering best practices, testing, and CI/CD methodologies.

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and a good understanding of storage, compute, networking, and identity management.

• Proven track record working in regulated environments, with knowledge of GMP, GxP, data integrity, and audit requirements.

• Experience integrating enterprise and manufacturing systems, ideally including SAP, MES, LIMS, and other OT/IT data sources.

• Pharmaceutical or life sciences industry experience is highly desirable, as is familiarity with modern lakehouse architectures, streaming technologies, data platform validation, and Databricks certifications.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Gruppo Bachem sta investendo in un nuovo sito a Sisslerfeld nella Svizzera nordoccidentale. Questo passo fa parte della nostra strategia a lungo termine per espandere la capacità produttiva. Il nuovo sito di produzione svolgerà un ruolo centrale nel raggiungimento di questi obiettivi. Per questo grande progetto di investimento CAPEX, stiamo cercando un Data Engineer.

I vostri compiti:

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere le pipeline di dati scalabili e in tempo reale sulla piattaforma Databricks utilizzando PySpark, SQL e Delta Lake.

• Costruire e ottimizzare le architetture di dati aziendali, inclusi i quadri di medaglione (Bronze, Silver, Gold), garantendo qualità dei dati, coerenza e affidabilità su tutti i livelli.

• Integrare la produzione e le fonti di dati business-critical come SAP, MES, LIMS, eQMS e gli storici di processo in un ecosistema di dati unificato.

• Sviluppare e gestire flussi di lavoro automatizzati di dati, processi di orchestrazione e prodotti di dati riutilizzabili per supportare analisi, reporting e eccellenza operativa.

• Implementare la governance dei dati, la sicurezza, la linea e gli standard di conformità, assicurando l'adesione a GMP, GxP, ALCOA+ e requisiti di integrità dei dati.

• Monitorare e migliorare le prestazioni della piattaforma di dati attraverso l'ottimizzazione del carico di lavoro, la gestione dei costi e l'adozione di best practice ingegneristiche, framework di test e processi CI/CD.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con scienziati di dati, ingegneri di processo, stakeholder aziendali, QA e team di validazione per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni di dati pronte alla produzione.

• Abilitare iniziative di analisi e machine learning avanzate fornendo set di dati curati, modelli di dati semantici, funzionalità di ingegneria e fondazioni di analisi self-service

Il tuo profilo:

• Bachelor o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria dei dati, Tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo relativo.

• 5+ anni di esperienza hands-on progettazione, costruzione e gestione di data pipeline e piattaforme di dati su scala aziendale.

• Forte esperienza nelle tecnologie Databricks, tra cui PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog e orchestrazione flusso di lavoro.

• Proficiente in SQL e Python, con una solida comprensione delle migliori pratiche di ingegneria del software, test e metodologie CI/CD.

• Esperienza con piattaforme di dati basate su cloud (AWS e/o Azure) e una buona comprensione di storage, calcolo, networking e gestione dell'identità.

• Provato record di traccia lavorando in ambienti regolamentati, con la conoscenza di GMP, GxP, integrità dei dati e requisiti di audit.

• Esperienza di integrazione di sistemi aziendali e produttivi, tra cui SAP, MES, LIMS e altre fonti di dati OT/IT.

• L'esperienza dell'industria farmaceutica o delle scienze della vita è altamente auspicabile, così come la familiarità con le moderne architetture di Lakehouse, le tecnologie di streaming, la convalida della piattaforma di dati e le certificazioni Databricks.

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne

• Ore lavorative flessibili con i giorni di ufficio e l'opzione per ottenere ulteriori giorni di vacanza attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Centro diurno gestito dall'azienda sul campus di Bachem a Bubendorf

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso a piattaforme di benefici con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Una vasta gamma di attività sportive gratuite sul Bachem Campus

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra posizione a Bubendorf!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site à Sisslerfeld, dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans notre stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. Pour ce projet d'investissement à grande échelle CAPEX, nous recherchons un ingénieur de données.

Vos tâches:

• Concevoir, développer et entretenir des pipelines de données en temps réel et par lots évolutives sur la plateforme Databricks en utilisant PySpark, SQL et Delta Lake.

• Construire et optimiser les architectures de données d'entreprise, y compris les cadres de médaillon (Bronze, Silver, Gold), en assurant la qualité des données, la cohérence et la fiabilité de toutes les couches.

• Intégrer les sources de données de fabrication et les sources de données critiques pour les entreprises comme SAP, MES, LIMS, eQMS et les historiens des processus dans un écosystème de données unifié.

• Élaborer et gérer des flux automatisés de données, des processus d'orchestration et des produits de données réutilisables pour soutenir l'analyse, la production de rapports et l'excellence opérationnelle.

• Mettre en oeuvre les normes de gouvernance, de sécurité, de lignage et de conformité des données, en veillant au respect des exigences en matière de BPF, GxP, ALCOA+ et d'intégrité des données.

• Surveiller et améliorer le rendement de la plate-forme de données grâce à l'optimisation de la charge de travail, à la gestion des coûts et à l'adoption de pratiques exemplaires en génie, de cadres d'essai et de processus d'IC/DC.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les data savants, les ingénieurs de processus, les intervenants commerciaux, l'AQ et les équipes de validation pour traduire les besoins commerciaux en solutions de données prêtes à la production.

• Activer les initiatives avancées en matière d'analyse et d'apprentissage automatique en fournissant des ensembles de données curés, des modèles de données sémantiques, des capacités d'ingénierie des fonctions et des bases d'analyse en libre-service

Votre profil:

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, génie des données, technologie de l'information ou un domaine connexe.

• 5+ ans d'expérience pratique dans la conception, la construction et l'exploitation de pipelines de données et de plateformes de données à l'échelle de l'entreprise.

• Forte expertise dans les technologies Databricks, y compris PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, et l'orchestration de workflow.

• Compétence en SQL et en Python, avec une bonne compréhension des meilleures pratiques en génie logiciel, des essais et des méthodologies CI/CD.

• Expérience des plateformes de données en nuage (AWS et/ou Azure) et bonne compréhension du stockage, du calcul, du réseautage et de la gestion de l'identité.

• Expérience éprouvée de travail dans des environnements réglementés, avec une connaissance des BPF, des GxP, de l'intégrité des données et des exigences de vérification.

• Expérience d'intégration des systèmes d'entreprise et de fabrication, y compris idéalement SAP, MES, LIMS et d'autres sources de données OT/IT.

• L'expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou des sciences de la vie est hautement souhaitable, tout comme la familiarité avec les architectures lacustres modernes, les technologies de streaming, la validation des plates-formes de données et les certifications Databricks.

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 – 100% , to design and implement SAP solutions for the establishment of our new planned GMP manufacturing site (Bachem Sisslerfeld).

The role combines deep expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply chain processes with a strong focus on modern, data-driven capabilities and digital innovation. This includes enabling integrated, intelligent, and highly automated processes based on advanced digital technologies. The successful candidate will contribute to building scalable, integrated, and future-ready SAP solutions to support digital transformation and operational excellence.

Your tasks:

• Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions supporting manufacturing and supply chain processes, ensuring compliant, standardized system build and deployment across the program

• Enable and optimize end-to-end business processes across production, supply chain, and quality in GMP-regulated environments, applying deep pharma/life science domain expertise

• Architect and implement cross-system integration across SAP and adjacent platforms (MES, LIMS, shopfloor automation), securing seamless data flow and process consistency across the landscape

• Drive digital innovation by delivering data-driven, highly automated processes and supporting the adoption of modern SAP technologies such as SAP Build and SAP AI Services

• Establish and maintain full regulatory compliance (GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001), supporting computer system validation (CSV), risk assessments, and audit readiness

The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership.

The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations.

In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.

Your tasks:

• Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments.

• Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems.

• Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities.

• Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live.

• Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability.

• Govern and coordinate external service providers, system integrators, and network vendors. Review designs, proposals, and delivery quality of suppliers.

• Ensure compliance with GxP, data integrity, and cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, ISO 27001) and support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory inspections.

• Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and validation-relevant deliverables.

• Transition into on-site owner for IT run services after project go-live by defining and establishing support models, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, and service KPIs.

• Drive network standardization, modernization, and lifecycle management.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture and infrastructure design in enterprise and industrial GxP environments with strong hands-on expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security.

• Proven experience in IT/OT integration and segmentation concepts with experience in large-scale project delivery and infrastructure coordination.

• Ability to translate architecture into practical, operationally sustainable solutions.

• Deep understanding of GxP-regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Strong knowledge of IT service management, incident/problem management, and operations governance.

• Strong coordination and communication skills across global teams and project stakeholders combined with technical authority and deescalation competence.

• Comfortable operating across design, delivery, and run phases.

• Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable

• Experience in regulated industries is a plus

• Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities.

• Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live.

• Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability.

• Deep understanding of GxP-regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Strong knowledge of IT service management, incident/problem management, and operations governance.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site prévu à Sisslerfeld dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner la future organisation.

Pour stimuler notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des professionnels hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe en TI globale, nous recherchons un ingénieur IT/OT Network & Infrastructure (a), expérimenté et avant-gardiste, 80 – 100%.

L'ingénieur du réseau et de l'infrastructure IT/OT est responsable de la conception, de la gestion et de l'opérationnalisation de l'infrastructure des réseaux industriels et d'entreprise dans les environnements IT et OT tout en soutenant directement la stratégie numérique de Bachem (c'est-à-dire la fabrication numérique, les concepts pharma 4.0), l'accent étant mis sur la réalisation de projets (nouveau site prévu de Sisslerfeld) et la propriété opérationnelle à long terme.

Ce rôle est l'interface clé entre les TI mondiales, les équipes de sites et les parties prenantes du projet, en veillant à ce que tous les composants du réseau et de l'hébergement soient alignés sur les normes de l'entreprise, les politiques de sécurité et les règlements GxP, tout en garantissant la disponibilité des infrastructures pour l'exécution des projets et les opérations durables.

Outre les responsabilités liées à l'architecture et à la prestation des services, le rôle du gestionnaire sur place est devenu le propriétaire des services de gestion des TI, assurant la stabilité des opérations, la coordination des fournisseurs et l'amélioration continue après l'achèvement du projet.

Vos tâches:

• Définir, concevoir et gouverner les architectures de réseau dans le cadre du projet de site BSF, en harmonie avec les architectures de réseau IT/OT mondiales dans les environnements d'entreprise et industriels.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des architectures IT/OT segmentées (zones, DMZ, VLAN, flux de données sécurisés) et prendre en charge des environnements industriels tels que SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES et systèmes d'atelier.

• Agir en tant que chef de file de l'infrastructure au cours du projet BSF, coordonner les activités de réseau et d'hébergement entre la gestion du site, les équipes de projet et les TI mondiales tout en veillant à ce que l'infrastructure (réseau, connectivité, hébergement, sécurité) soit prête à appuyer toutes les étapes du projet et les activités de mise en service.

• Conduire l'harmonisation entre la conception du projet et les normes ministérielles, y compris les examens et les approbations de l'architecture. Appuyer les activités de déploiement du site, y compris les évaluations, la validation de la conception, les coupes, les essais et la mise en service.

• Coordonner l'intégration des plateformes de réseau et d'hébergement (on-prem, hybride, cloud) dans les solutions d'infrastructure de bout en bout et veiller à ce que les systèmes soient conçus pour une grande disponibilité, sécurité, évolutivité et durabilité opérationnelle.

• Gouvernance et coordination des fournisseurs de services externes, des intégrateurs de systèmes et des fournisseurs de réseaux. Examiner les conceptions, les propositions et la qualité de livraison des fournisseurs.

• Assurer la conformité aux normes GxP, d'intégrité des données et de cybersécurité (p. ex. CEI 62443, ISO 27001) et appuyer les vérifications, les évaluations des risques et les inspections réglementaires.

• Maintenir la documentation sur l'architecture, les normes et les produits livrables pertinents à la validation.

• Transition vers un propriétaire sur place pour les services de gestion informatique après le lancement du projet en définissant et en établissant des modèles de support, des runbooks, un suivi, des chemins d'escalade et des KPI de service.

• Favoriser la normalisation du réseau, la modernisation et la gestion du cycle de vie.

Votre profil:

• Expérience étendue dans l'architecture réseau et la conception d'infrastructures dans les environnements GxP d'entreprise et industrielle avec une solide expertise pratique en LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routage, commutation, pare-feu et sécurité réseau.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière d ' intégration et de segmentation des technologies de l ' information et des télécommunications, avec expérience de l ' exécution à grande échelle des projets et de la coordination des infrastructures.

• Capacité de traduire l'architecture en solutions pratiques et opérationnelles durables.

• Connaissance approfondie des environnements réglementés par le GxP et des exigences de conformité.

• Connaissance approfondie de la gestion des services de TI, de la gestion des incidents et des problèmes et de la gouvernance des opérations.

• Renforcement des compétences en matière de coordination et de communication entre les équipes mondiales et les acteurs du projet, ainsi que de l'autorité technique et de la compétence en matière de désescalade.

• Un fonctionnement confortable tout au long des phases de conception, de livraison et d'exécution.

• Fluent en anglais; les compétences en langue allemande sont hautement souhaitables

• L'expérience dans les industries réglementées est un plus

Notre offre

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec des possibilités de développement interne

• Heures de travail flexibles avec les jours de bureau à domicile et une option pour obtenir des jours de vacances supplémentaires grâce à la réduction de la charge de travail

• Développement des employés grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de formation internes et externes

• 60 % de la couverture des cotisations de la caisse de retraite par Bachem ainsi que l'option pour la disposition de pension extra-obligatoire avec notre Régime de retraite Plus

• Accès à la plate-forme de prestations avec des rabais de partenaires externes

Aimeriez-vous stimuler l'innovation avec nous ?

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir vos documents de candidature complets via notre portail d'applications.

En savoir plus sur le groupe Bachem et s'inspirer de notre environnement de travail passionnant à notre nouvel emplacement à Stein!

jobs.title: MES System Engineer (a), 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated MES System Engineer (a), 80 - 100%.

Your Tasks:

• Lead the full lifecycle management of the Körber PAS-X Manufacturing Execution System (MES), including solution design, configuration, deployment, validation, maintenance, and continuous improvement

• Support the design and implementation of next-generation MES architectures aligned with smart manufacturing, digital plant strategies, and Pharma 4.0 initiatives

• Drive MES activities across the new facility startup lifecycle, from project design and commissioning through qualification, go-live, and commercial manufacturing operations

• Collaborate with manufacturing, automation, IT/OT, quality, engineering, and global digital teams to define and implement scalable PAS-X solutions

• Translate business and manufacturing process requirements into robust MES functional and technical designs

• Ensure high system availability, reliability, and performance for GMP-regulated manufacturing environments, including on-call and operational support where required

• Manage change control, deviation investigations, incident management, and problem resolution in close collaboration with IT, operations, and system vendors

• Support integration of PAS-X with enterprise and shopfloor systems including ERP, LIMS, Historians, Automation and integration platforms

• Contribute to MES platform standardization, template strategies, and deployment methodologies across global manufacturing sites

• Maintain GMP-compliant documentation throughout the system lifecycle, including specifications, risk assessments, validation deliverables, and operational procedures

• Act as MES Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits, inspections, qualification activities, and regulatory interactions

• Support commissioning, qualification, and computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) activities in accordance with GAMP5 and data integrity requirements

Your Profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical discipline

• 4 – 6 years of strong hands-on experience with Körber PAS-X MES in regulated pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing environments

• Proven experience supporting MES implementation projects for new manufacturing facilities, site expansions, or large-scale digital transformation programs

• Solid understanding of next-generation MES/IT-OT architectures, system integrations, and smart factory concepts

• Experience with PAS-X modules such as electronic batch records (EBR), materials management, weigh & dispense, workflow design, and master batch record modeling is highly desirable

• Administer a 24/7 operational MES System, ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.

• Knowledge of system integration technologies, infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity within GMP manufacturing environments

• Experience with computerized system validation (CSV/CSA), data integrity, and regulatory compliance requirements including GAMP5, Annex 11, and 21 CFR Part 11

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, commissioning and qualification activities, and operational readiness for facility startup

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced project and operational environments

• Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable

Our offer

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platform with discounts from external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our new location in Stein!

• Collabora con team di produzione, automazione, IT/OT, qualità, ingegneria e digitale globale per definire e implementare soluzioni scalabili PAS-X

• Tradurre i requisiti di processo di business e produzione in robusti disegni funzionali e tecnici MES

• Garantire un'elevata disponibilità, affidabilità e prestazioni del sistema per ambienti di produzione regolati da GMP, incluso il supporto operativo e on-call, laddove necessario

• Gestire il controllo dei cambiamenti, le indagini di deviazione, la gestione degli incidenti e la risoluzione dei problemi in stretta collaborazione con IT, operazioni e fornitori di sistemi

• Integrazione di supporto PAS-X con sistemi enterprise e shopfloor tra cui piattaforme ERP, LIMS, Historians, Automation e Integrazione

• Contribuisci alla standardizzazione della piattaforma MES, alle strategie dei modelli e alle metodologie di distribuzione nei siti di produzione globali

• Mantenere la documentazione conforme a GMP in tutto il ciclo di vita del sistema, comprese le specifiche, le valutazioni di rischio, i risultati di validazione e le procedure operative

• Atto come MES Oggetto Matter Expert (SME) durante gli audit, le ispezioni, le attività di qualificazione e le interazioni normative

• Supporta le attività di messa in servizio, di qualificazione e di validazione computerizzata del sistema (CSV/CSA) secondo GAMP5 e i requisiti di integrità dei dati

Il tuo profilo:

• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Tecnologia dell'informazione, Scienza informatica, Ingegneria farmaceutica, o una disciplina tecnica correlata

• 4 – 6 anni di forte esperienza pratica con Körber PAS-X MES in ambienti di produzione farmaceutica o biotecnologia regolamentati

• Esperienza comprovata che supporta progetti di implementazione MES per nuove strutture di produzione, espansioni dei siti o programmi di trasformazione digitale su larga scala

• Solida comprensione di architetture MES/IT-OT di nuova generazione, integrazioni di sistema e concetti di fabbrica intelligenti

• Esperienza con moduli PAS-X come record elettronici di lotti (EBR), gestione dei materiali, pesare e distribuire, progettazione del flusso di lavoro e modellazione master batch record è altamente auspicabile

• Amministra un sistema operativo MES 24/7, garantendo elevata disponibilità, affidabilità, prestazioni e disponibilità di emergenza.

• Conoscenza delle tecnologie di integrazione del sistema, infrastrutture, networking, virtualizzazione e sicurezza informatica all'interno degli ambienti di produzione GMP

• Esperienza con validazione computerizzata del sistema (CSV/CSA), integrità dei dati e requisiti di conformità normativi tra cui GAMP5, Allegato 11 e 21 CFR Parte 11

• Forte comprensione dei processi di produzione farmaceutica, delle attività di messa in servizio e di qualificazione, e la disponibilità operativa per l'avvio delle strutture

• Eccellente gestione, comunicazione e competenze di collaborazione tra le parti interessate

• Forte capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi con la capacità di operare efficacemente in ambienti operativi e di progetto veloci

• Fluente in inglese; le competenze linguistiche tedesche sono altamente auspicabili

La nostra offerta

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Ore lavorative flessibili con giorni di ufficio domestico e un'opzione per ottenere giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Sviluppo dei dipendenti attraverso numerose opportunità di formazione interna ed esterna

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso ai vantaggi piattaforma con sconti da parte di partner esterni

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra nuova posizione a Stein!

Der neue Produktionsstandort wird eine zentrale Rolle bei der Erreichung dieser Ziele spielen. Die Designphase des Projekts bietet Ihnen einzigartige Möglichkeiten, die zukünftige Organisation zu gestalten.

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, sind wir ständig auf der Suche nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Um unser Team in der globalen IT zu stärken, suchen wir einen dedizierten MES System Engineer (a), 80 - 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Führen Sie das vollständige Lebenszyklusmanagement des Körber PAS-X Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), einschließlich Lösungsdesign, Konfiguration, Bereitstellung, Validierung, Wartung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung

• Unterstützung des Designs und der Implementierung von MES-Architekturen der nächsten Generation, die auf intelligente Fertigung, digitale Anlagenstrategien und Pharma 4.0-Initiativen ausgerichtet sind

• Förderung der MES-Aktivitäten über den gesamten Lebenszyklus der neuen Einrichtung hinweg, von der Projektgestaltung und Inbetriebnahme über Qualifizierung, Go-Live und kommerzielle Fertigung

• Zusammenarbeit mit Fertigungs-, Automatisierungs-, IT/OT-, Qualitäts-, Engineering- und globalen digitalen Teams zur Definition und Implementierung skalierbarer PAS-X-Lösungen

• Übersetzen von Geschäfts- und Fertigungsprozessanforderungen in robuste funktionale und technische MES-Designs

• Gewährleistung einer hohen Systemverfügbarkeit, -zuverlässigkeit und -leistung für GMP-regulierte Fertigungsumgebungen, einschließlich Bereitschafts- und Betriebsunterstützung, falls erforderlich

• Verwalten Sie Change Control, Abweichungsuntersuchungen, Incident Management und Problemlösung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit IT-, Operations- und Systemanbietern

• Unterstützung der Integration von PAS-X mit Enterprise- und Shopfloor-Systemen einschließlich ERP, LIMS, Historians, Automatisierungs- und Integrationsplattformen

• Beitrag zur Standardisierung der MES-Plattform, Vorlagenstrategien und Bereitstellungsmethoden an globalen Fertigungsstandorten

• Pflegen Sie die GMP-konforme Dokumentation während des gesamten Systemlebenszyklus, einschließlich Spezifikationen, Risikobewertungen, Validierungsergebnisse und Betriebsverfahren

• Handeln Sie als MES Subject Matter Expert (KMU) bei Audits, Inspektionen, Qualifizierungsaktivitäten und regulatorischen Interaktionen

• Unterstützung von Inbetriebnahme-, Qualifizierungs- und Computersystemvalidierungsaktivitäten (CSV/CSA) gemäß GAMP5 und Datenintegritätsanforderungen

Ihr Profil:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Automatisierungstechnik, Informationstechnologie, Informatik, Pharmazeutik oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin

• 4 – 6 Jahre starke praktische Erfahrung mit Körber PAS-X MES in regulierten pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen Fertigungsumgebungen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Unterstützung von MES-Implementierungsprojekten für neue Fertigungsanlagen, Standorterweiterungen oder groß angelegte digitale Transformationsprogramme

• Solides Verständnis von MES/IT-OT-Architekturen der nächsten Generation, Systemintegrationen und Smart Factory-Konzepten

• Erfahrung mit PAS-X-Modulen wie Electronic Batch Records (EBR), Materialmanagement, Wiegen & Dispense, Workflow-Design und Master Batch Record Modellierung ist sehr wünschenswert

• Verwalten Sie ein 24/7 betriebsbereites MES-System, das hohe Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Leistung und Bereitschaft zur Wiederherstellung von Katastrophen gewährleistet.

• Kenntnisse über Systemintegrationstechnologien, Infrastruktur, Vernetzung, Virtualisierung und Cybersicherheit in GMP-Fertigungsumgebungen

• Erfahrung mit Computersystemvalidierung (CSV/CSA), Datenintegrität und regulatorischen Compliance-Anforderungen einschließlich GAMP5, Annex 11 und 21 CFR Part 11

• Starkes Verständnis der pharmazeutischen Herstellungsprozesse, Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierungsaktivitäten und Einsatzbereitschaft für die Inbetriebnahme von Anlagen

• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Stakeholdermanagement, Kommunikation und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

• Starke Analyse- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, in schnelllebigen Projekt- und Betriebsumgebungen effektiv zu arbeiten

• fließend Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind sehr wünschenswert

Unser Angebot

• Ein dynamisches und schnell wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home-Office-Tagen und eine Option für zusätzliche Urlaubstage durch Arbeitsbelastungsreduzierung

• Mitarbeiterentwicklung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• 60% Deckung der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem sowie Option auf außerobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Pensionsplan Plus

• Zugang zur Leistungsplattform mit Rabatten von externen Partnern

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site prévu à Sisslerfeld dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner la future organisation.

Pour stimuler notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des professionnels hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe en TI globale, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur système MES dédié (a), 80 - 100%.

Vos tâches :

• Diriger la gestion complète du cycle de vie du Körber PAS-X Manufacturing Execution System (MES), y compris la conception de la solution, la configuration, le déploiement, la validation, la maintenance et l'amélioration continue

• Soutenir la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures MES de nouvelle génération alignées sur la fabrication intelligente, les stratégies d'usines numériques et les initiatives Pharma 4.0

• Diriger les activités du MES tout au long du cycle de vie des nouvelles installations, de la conception et de la mise en service des projets à la qualification, à la mise en service et à la fabrication commerciale

• Collaborer avec des équipes de fabrication, d'automatisation, d'IT/OT, de qualité, d'ingénierie et de digital mondial pour définir et mettre en œuvre des solutions PAS-X évolutives

• Traduire les exigences des processus d'affaires et de fabrication en conceptions fonctionnelles et techniques robustes MES

• Assurer une disponibilité, une fiabilité et une performance élevées du système pour les environnements de fabrication réglementés par les BPF, y compris le soutien opérationnel et sur appel, au besoin

• Gérer le contrôle du changement, les enquêtes sur les écarts, la gestion des incidents et la résolution des problèmes en étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs de TI, d'opérations et de systèmes

• Soutenir l'intégration de PAS-X avec des systèmes d'entreprise et d'atelier incluant ERP, LIMS, Historiens, Automatisation et plateformes d'intégration

• Contribuer à la normalisation de la plate-forme MES, aux stratégies modèles et aux méthodologies de déploiement dans les sites de fabrication mondiaux

• Maintenir la documentation conforme aux BPF tout au long du cycle de vie du système, y compris les spécifications, les évaluations des risques, les produits livrables de validation et les procédures opérationnelles

• Agir à titre d'expert en matière de SEM (EMS) durant les vérifications, les inspections, les activités de qualification et les interactions réglementaires

• Soutien aux activités de mise en service, de qualification et de validation informatisée des systèmes (CSV/CSA) conformément au GAMP5 et aux exigences d'intégrité des données

Votre profil:

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en ingénierie d'automatisation, technologie de l'information, informatique, génie pharmaceutique ou une discipline technique connexe

• 4 – 6 ans d'expérience pratique avec Körber PAS-X MES dans des environnements de fabrication pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique réglementés

• Expérience éprouvée à l'appui de projets de mise en oeuvre du MES pour de nouvelles installations de fabrication, d'agrandissement de sites ou de programmes de transformation numérique à grande échelle

• Compréhension solide des architectures MES/IT-OT de nouvelle génération, des intégrations système et des concepts d'usine intelligente

• Expérience avec les modules PAS-X tels que les enregistrements électroniques par lots (EBR), la gestion des matériaux, la pesée et la distribution, la conception des flux de travail et la modélisation des enregistrements par lots maîtres est hautement souhaitable

• Administrer un système opérationnel MES 24/7, assurant une disponibilité élevée, la fiabilité, les performances et la capacité de reprise après sinistre.

• Connaissance des technologies d'intégration des systèmes, de l'infrastructure, du réseautage, de la virtualisation et de la cybersécurité dans les environnements de fabrication des BPF

• Expérience de la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV/CSA), de l'intégrité des données et des exigences réglementaires en matière de conformité, y compris GAMP5, annexe 11 et 21 CFR, partie 11

• Une bonne compréhension des processus de fabrication pharmaceutique, des activités de mise en service et de qualification et de la préparation opérationnelle au démarrage des installations

• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants, en communication et en collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de fonctionner efficacement dans des environnements opérationnels et des projets rapides

• Fluent en anglais; les compétences en langue allemande sont hautement souhaitables

Notre offre

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec des possibilités de développement interne

• Heures de travail flexibles avec les jours de bureau à domicile et une option pour obtenir des jours de vacances supplémentaires grâce à la réduction de la charge de travail

• Développement des employés grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de formation internes et externes

• 60 % de la couverture des cotisations de la caisse de retraite par Bachem ainsi que l'option pour une disposition de pension extra-obligatoire avec notre Régime de retraite Plus

• Accès à la plate-forme de prestations avec des réductions de partenaires externes

Nous avons hâte de recevoir tous vos documents de candidature via notre portail d'applications.

En savoir plus sur le groupe Bachem et s'inspirer de notre environnement de travail passionnant à notre nouvel emplacement à Stein!

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Forschung & Entwicklung in Bubendorf/BL suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n  Scientist Peptidwirkstoffe R&D Flow-Chemie (a), 100%. Das Arbeitsgebiet umfasst zahlreiche unterschiedliche Schritte der modernen Synthese von peptidischen Wirkstoffen, Peptidfragmenten und Aminosäurebausteinen in Lösung, sowie diverse Technologien zur Aufkonzentration und Isolation der Produkte.

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Analyse und Interpretation von Experimenten sowie die Darstellung der erhaltenen Ergebnisse

• Planung und zeitgerechte Durchführung von Entwicklungsarbeiten bzw. Prozessoptimierungen in Kooperation mit anderen Abteilungen unter Berücksichtigung von Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Sicherheit

• Skalierung von Chemie und Equipment vom Labor auf den Pilotmassstab

• Fokus auf den LPPS Flow-Chemie Bereich (Organische Chemie in Lösung, Peptidkupplungen, Schutzgruppenchemie, Extraktion, Fällung, Kristallisation)

• Verfassen von Berichten und Erstellen von Präsentationen zu den durchgeführten Arbeiten für interne und externe Kunden

• Aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Bachem Flow-Chemie-Plattform

• Aktive Beteiligung an der ständigen Verbesserung unseres Equipments und der Arbeitsabläufe sowie Unterhalt der Laborinfrastruktur

Ihr Profil:

• Masterabschluss oder Promotion in Chemical Engineering oder Chemie

• Erfahrungen in der präparativen organischen Synthese einschliesslich Flow-Chemie und ein Faible für Prozesstechnik

• Strukturierte, genaue und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, die es erlaubt, jederzeit den Überblick zu behalten

• Ausgeprägte kommunikative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Zuverlässigkeit, Selbstständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

jobs.description:
To support our continued organic growth, we are looking for a dedicated and experienced Manager QA (a), 100% (temporary, 12 months) to strengthen our External Supply Quality Assurance team.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring compliance with GMP requirements and quality standards across our external supply network. Working closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will play a key role in maintaining the quality, safety, and reliability of externally sourced materials and services. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic, fast-growing, and internationally operating pharmaceutical environment.

Your tasks:

• Vendor Incident Management: Independently handling, investigating, and following up on quality incidents and complaints involving external vendors (including SCAR processing and CAPA control).

• Change Requests: Processing change notifications and change requests from vendors.

• Vendor (Re-)Qualification: Actively monitoring, executing, and coordinating vendor qualifications as well as periodic re-qualifications to ensure compliant supply chains.

• Approving vendors and managing the Trusted Vendor Program, with an ongoing expansion to include equipment suppliers and outsourcing service providers. .

• Interface Coordination & Support: Closely collaborating across departments with Direct Procurement, QC Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, and local QA teams to master current operational challenges.

Your profile:

• Education: University degree Master or PhD with focus on natural sciences (Chemistry, Process Engineering, Pharmacy, Food Technology or similar field) or an education with equivalent, multi-year professional experience.

• Professional Experience: At least 5 years of sound professional experience in quality assurance within the pharmaceutical industry or a pharma CDMO organization.

• Expertise & Working Style: A pronounced sense of quality and compliance with a sharp eye for details, sound knowledge of GMP regulations (EU/US/CH), and experience in dealing professionally with vendors.

• Language Skills: Fluent English spoken and written (C1 required); German skills are an advantage.

• IT & Systems: Routine handling of electronic management and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, MasterControl, and DocuSign) as well as common MS Office applications.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days

• Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.
