In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili di garantire il rispetto dei requisiti GMP e degli standard di qualità nella nostra rete di fornitura esterna. Lavorando a stretto contatto con fornitori, produttori di contratti e stakeholder interfunzionali, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel mantenere la qualità, la sicurezza e l'affidabilità dei materiali e dei servizi esterni. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di contribuire a un ambiente farmaceutico dinamico, in rapida crescita e a livello internazionale.

I vostri compiti:

• Gestione degli incidenti del fornitore: gestione indipendente, indagine e seguito su incidenti e reclami di qualità che coinvolgono fornitori esterni (tra cui elaborazione SCAR e controllo CAPA).

• Change Requests: Elaborazione delle notifiche di cambiamento e modifica delle richieste dei fornitori.

• Fornitore (Re-)Qualificazione: Monitoraggio attivo, esecuzione e coordinamento delle qualifiche dei fornitori, nonché riqualifica periodica per garantire catene di fornitura conformi.

• Migliorare i fornitori e gestire il programma Trusted Vendor, con una continua espansione per includere fornitori di attrezzature e fornitori di servizi di outsourcing .

• Interface Coordination & Support: Collaborare con i dipartimenti con Direct Procurement, QC Compliance, Regulatory Affairs e i team QA locali per gestire le attuali sfide operative.

Il tuo profilo:

• Istruzione: laurea magistrale o dottorato con focus sulle scienze naturali (Chimica, Ingegneria dei processi, Farmacia, Tecnologia alimentare o campo simile) o un'educazione con esperienza professionale equivalente e pluriennale.

• Esperienza professionale: almeno 5 anni di solida esperienza professionale nell'assicurazione della qualità all'interno dell'industria farmaceutica o di un'organizzazione CDMO farmaceutica.

• Expertise & Working Style: Un senso pronunciato della qualità e del rispetto di un occhio tagliente per i dettagli, la conoscenza sonora dei regolamenti GMP (EU/US/CH), e l'esperienza nel trattare professionalmente con i fornitori.

• Competenze linguistiche: Inglese fluente parlato e scritto (C1 richiesto); competenze tedesche sono un vantaggio.

• IT & Systems: gestione ordinaria della gestione elettronica e sistemi ERP (ad esempio, SAP, MasterControl e DocuSign) nonché applicazioni di MS Office comuni.

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Ore lavorative flessibili con i giorni di ufficio

Pour soutenir notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons une QA Manager dédiée et expérimentée (a), 100% (temporaire, 12 mois) pour renforcer notre équipe externe d'assurance de la qualité de l'approvisionnement.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez chargé d'assurer la conformité aux exigences des BPF et aux normes de qualité sur notre réseau d'approvisionnement externe. En étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs, les fabricants contractuels et les intervenants interfonctionnels, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le maintien de la qualité, de la sécurité et de la fiabilité des matériaux et services d'origine externe. Cette position offre l'occasion de contribuer à un environnement pharmaceutique dynamique, en croissance rapide et opérationnel à l'échelle internationale.

Vos tâches:

• Gestion des incidents impliquant des fournisseurs : Traitement, enquête et suivi indépendants des incidents et des plaintes de qualité impliquant des fournisseurs externes (y compris le traitement SCAR et le contrôle de l'ACP).

• Demandes de changement : Traitement des notifications de changement et des demandes de changement des fournisseurs.

• Fournisseur (Re-)Qualification: Surveiller, exécuter et coordonner activement les qualifications des fournisseurs ainsi que les requalifications périodiques pour assurer la conformité des chaînes d'approvisionnement.

• Approuver les fournisseurs et gérer le Programme des fournisseurs fiables, avec une expansion continue pour inclure les fournisseurs d'équipement et les fournisseurs de services d'externalisation.

• Coordination et soutien de l'interface : Collaboration étroite entre les ministères avec les équipes d'approvisionnement direct, de conformité au QC, d'affaires réglementaires et d'AQ locales pour relever les défis opérationnels actuels.

Votre profil:

• Études : Maîtrise universitaire ou doctorat axé sur les sciences naturelles (chimie, génie des procédés, pharmacie, technologie alimentaire ou domaine similaire) ou une formation ayant une expérience professionnelle équivalente et pluriannuelle.

• Expérience professionnelle : Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle solide dans l'assurance de la qualité au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou d'un organisme CDMO pharmaceutique.

• Expertise et style de travail: un sens prononcé de la qualité et de la conformité avec un œil aigu pour les détails, une bonne connaissance des règlements sur les BPF (EU/US/CH), et l'expérience dans les rapports professionnels avec les fournisseurs.

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Own core ITSM processes — Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration and Event Management globally, ensuring SLA compliance and alignment with SOPs/ITIL.

• Define performance metrics — Set KPIs/SLAs, build dashboards, deliver monthly reports and manage escalations

• Maintain process documentation — Create and update SOPs, training materials and ensure role clarity with tracked training records

• Drive Problem Management — Run RCA processes, remediation follow‑up, stakeholder communication and proactive risk identification

• Manage Known Errors — Maintain Key Issue databases and ensure workarounds are documented and shared

• Lead CMDB governance — Own CMDB strategy, CI lifecycle accuracy, data models and service dependency mapping

• Ensure CMDB data quality — Perform audits, reconciliation, issue resolution and integration with change/incident/monitoring processes

• Optimize CMDB tooling — Enhance CMDB/asset platform usage, automate via discovery tools and report on configuration compliance

• Run Event Management — Ensure monitoring coverage, correct event filtering/correlation and impact‑based escalation

• Define event automation — Maintain thresholds, notifications and automated/self‑healing responses

Your profile:

• 7+ years in IT Operations, Service Management or a related technical field, including Service Operations or Service Delivery Management

• Hands-on experience in Incident, Problem, Configuration and/or Event Management; Major Incident Management is an advantage

• ITIL Foundation certification required; ITIL Intermediate/Expert an asset.

• Strong cross-domain technical expertise across infrastructure, applications, databases, and security, with a deep understanding of their interdependencies—including modern workplace devices, application servers, and backend platforms

• Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, correlations and root causes, with the ability to lead technical RCA calls

• Excellent communication skills, translating technical detail into business- and user-friendly language

• Strong facilitation and leadership under pressure, with the ability to work across global teams and manage stakeholders at all levels

• Experience with monitoring, log analysis and service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, LogicMonitor).

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen Quality Assurance team, we are looking for a dedicated and experienced Manager QA Projects (a), 100%.

Your tasks:

• Represent QA in product-related projects at the Bubendorf site.

I vostri compiti:

• Rappresentare QA nei progetti relativi al prodotto presso il sito Bubendorf.

• Valutare e prendere decisioni su argomenti pertinenti QA all'interno di singoli progetti.

• Coordinare i compiti specifici del progetto all'interno dei dipartimenti QA e agire come un contatto chiave per altri dipartimenti (ad esempio, Produzione, Controllo Qualità, Project Management) per quanto riguarda la conformità cGMP e la risoluzione dei problemi.

• Definire le strategie di controllo e le strategie globali del ciclo di vita dallo sviluppo di GMP attraverso la validazione dei processi per supportare la produzione commerciale.

• Verificare e approvare documenti GMP, modifiche, report di deviazione e CAPA.

• Servire come punto di contatto per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni su questioni relative al QA e rappresentare il QA nelle riunioni tra Bachem e i clienti.

Il tuo profilo:

• Master o Ph.D. in chimica, biologia, farmacia o un campo tecnico comparabile.

• Minimo di 2 anni di esperienza professionale nella gestione del progetto e garanzia di qualità nell'industria chimica/farmaceutica.

• Forte comprensione di argomenti QA, solida conoscenza cGMP (EU-GMP, FDA), e l'esperienza nel sostenere le validazioni di processo, compresa la gestione del rischio.

• Professionista strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con un alto livello di comprensione e forti capacità comunicative, in grado di trasmettere chiaramente argomenti complessi internamente ed esternamente.

• Un apprendimento rapido con una personalità resiliente, orientata al servizio e flessibile che prospera negli ambienti di squadra e prende decisioni sicure.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta sia in tedesco che in inglese.

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne

• Ore lavorative flessibili con giorni di ufficio domestico e un'opzione per ottenere giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso a piattaforme con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Una vasta gamma di attività sportive gratuite sul Bachem Campus

jobs.description:
To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are looking for a highly qualified leader to strengthen our Global IT Department as Head of MES & PI Competence Center (a), 80 - 100%.

This global leadership role is pivotal in shaping the future of our Digital Manufacturing capabilities. Reporting to the Head of Operations IT and serving as a key member of the Digital Manufacturing Council, you define the strategic direction and ensure the sustainable evolution of our MES and PI landscape as a core enabler of operational excellence, scalability, and data-driven manufacturing. Together with our internal and external partners, you translate business priorities into a clear application roadmap, strengthen governance and partner ecosystems, and ensure that our Digital Manufacturing solutions create measurable value across the organization.

Your tasks:

• Define and maintain the application strategy and roadmap for the Digital Manufacturing landscape in alignment with business unit priorities, business objectives and the Bachem IT application strategy.

• Collaborate with business units to manage their demand, understand their requirements, ensure prioritization, and align solutions with business needs.

• Oversee the implementation and operation of Digital Manufacturing solutions, from planning and development to deployment, continuous improvement, and ongoing support.

• Ensure compliance with established processes for IT service management and computer system validation during application development, maintenance, and support.

• Collaborate closely with project managers, IT, OT, and business SMEs to ensure Digital Manufacturing projects deliver the expected value.

• Lead and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Evaluate, select, and manage third-party vendors and partners with the support of IT Operational Excellence and GRC.

Your profile

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

• Proven experience in a leadership role overseeing Digital Manufacturing applications and projects in a regulated pharmaceutical, chemical or manufacturing environment.

• Experience with MES, process historian, or shopfloor-related IT/OT applications such as Körber PAS-X or AVEVA PI.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships at all levels.

• Leadership: Inspire and guide teams towards achieving ambitious goals.

• Communication: Articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Problem-Solving: Address challenges with innovative and effective solutions.

• Prioritization: Ability to focus on activities that create measurable business value.

• Collaboration: Foster a collaborative, inclusive work environment and a can-do attitude.

• Adaptability: Navigate and lead through change in a dynamic business environment.

• Excellent written and spoken English and German skills

Our offer:

• A key leadership role with global impact, offering the opportunity to shape our MES & PI Competence Center and drive the digital transformation of our manufacturing landscape

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

• Collaborare con le unità aziendali per gestire la loro domanda, comprendere le loro esigenze, garantire la priorità e allineare le soluzioni con le esigenze aziendali.

• Superare l'implementazione e il funzionamento delle soluzioni di Digital Manufacturing, dalla pianificazione e sviluppo alla distribuzione, al miglioramento continuo e al supporto continuo.

• Assicurare la conformità ai processi consolidati per la gestione dei servizi IT e la validazione del sistema informatico durante lo sviluppo delle applicazioni, la manutenzione e il supporto.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i project manager, IT, OT e le PMI aziendali per garantire che i progetti di Digital Manufacturing forniscano il valore atteso.

• Leader e mentore di un team altamente performante, promuovendo una cultura di innovazione, collaborazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Valuta, seleziona e gestisci fornitori e partner di terze parti con il supporto di IT Operational Excellence e GRC.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea in Informatica, Informatica o in un campo relativo.

• Esperienza dimostrata in un ruolo di leadership che supervisiona le applicazioni e i progetti di Digital Manufacturing in un ambiente farmaceutico, chimico o manifatturiero regolamentato.

• Esperienza con MES, storico del processo, o applicazioni IT/OT relative a shopfloor come Körber PAS-X o AVEVA PI.

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali con la capacità di costruire relazioni a tutti i livelli.

• Leadership: Ispirare e guidare i team per raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi.

• Comunicazione: articolare concetti tecnici complessi agli stakeholder non tecnici.

• Problem-Solving: affrontare le sfide con soluzioni innovative ed efficaci.

• Prioritizzazione: Capacità di concentrarsi su attività che creano un valore commerciale misurabile.

• Collaborazione: promuovere un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e inclusivo e un atteggiamento in grado di fare.

• Adaptability: Navigare e condurre attraverso il cambiamento in un ambiente aziendale dinamico.

• Eccellente scritto e parlato inglese e tedesco competenze

La nostra offerta:

• Un ruolo chiave di leadership con impatto globale, offrendo l'opportunità di modellare il nostro MES & PI Competence Center e guidare la trasformazione digitale del nostro paesaggio manifatturiero

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne

• Ore lavorative flessibili con giorni di ufficio domestico e un'opzione per ottenere giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Centro diurno gestito dall'azienda nel campus di Bachem a Bubendorf

• 60% di copertura dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e l'opzione per la fornitura di pensione extra-obbligatoria con il nostro Piano Pensione Plus

• Accesso a piattaforme con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Una vasta gamma di attività sportive gratuite sul Bachem Campus

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i tuoi documenti applicativi completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro emozionante nella nostra posizione a Bubendorf!

Ce rôle de leadership mondial est essentiel pour façonner l'avenir de nos capacités de fabrication numérique. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Bachem, we are rolling out Microsoft 365 Copilot across the organization along with user enablement. In parallel, we want to build Copilot Studio know-how internally in order to implement several more complex use cases.

To support this, we are offering an internship in our IT team where you will help operate and optimize the M365 Copilot platform and, hands-on, develop Copilot Studio agents – gaining practical experience across a modern Microsoft productivity and low-code environment.

Your tasks

M365 Copilot Platform (Testing & Optimization)

• Test M365 Copilot functionality and newly released features

• Analyze usage – adoption, usage patterns, and optimization potential

• Support the configuration of M365 Copilot

• Take over user enablement from the external partner once their project ends

Copilot Studio Agent Development

• Sharpen and flesh out several use cases, including requirements gathering with the business departments

• Implement the use cases technically, including the integration of systems via Model Context Protocol (MCP)

• Build up Copilot Studio know-how as an internal capability

• Document use cases and platform configurations in Confluence

Your profile

• Currently studying or recently graduated in computer science, business informatics, or a related field

• Interest in Microsoft 365, AI-assisted tooling, and low-code / productivity platforms

• Analytical mindset with an eye for usage data and optimization potential

• Hands-on and curious – keen to build Copilot Studio skills and deliver real use cases

• Good communication skills for gathering requirements together with business departments

• Fluent English; German is a plus

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

jobs.title: Senior Project Procurement Lead (a) 100% - Sisslerfeld

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Senior Procurement del Progetto (a) al 100% - Sisslerfeld

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is planning a future site in Sisslefeld in Northwestern Switzerland. As part of Bachem’ s long-term strategy, the planned site is expected to strengthen the company’s global manufacturing network and to expand future production capacity. Joining the team at this stage offers unique opportunities to help shape a new site organization and contribute to Bachem’s growth journey.

The project offers a unique opportunity to help shape one of the most significant pharm aceutical CAPEX investments in Switzerland. To strengthen our Global Project organization, we are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Project Procurement Lead (a) 100%.

Your responsibilities:

Lead the procurement workstream of Bachem Sisslerfeld and act as the single procurement point of contact. Coordinate all procurement activities across Category Managers, Engineering, PMO and project leadership while ensuring optimal commercial outcomes.

• Act as Procurement Project Lead (PPL) for the Bachem Sisslerfeld Program and serve as the single point of contact for all project procurement activities.

• Define and drive the overall procurement, sourcing and commercial strategy in close alignment with Project Management and Engineering.

• Coordinate and align procurement activities across all CAPEX Category Managers responsible for Construction, Equipment, Installation & Interieur, Automation and Engineering Services.

• Support and partially lead commercial negotiations and award recommendations for major contracts, strategic suppliers and critical project packages.

• Own procurement governance, risk management and ensure reporting across the project procurement portfolio.

• Partner closely with Legal to support contract reviews of complex contracts, orders and amendments,

• Prepare and drive claims and commercial disputes in cooperation with the Category Manager, Legal and PMO.

• Drive contract and change order management, ensuring commercial risks and opportunities are identified and properly managed throughout the project lifecycle.

• Represent Procurement in project leadership meetings, steering committees and executive stakeholder reviews.

• Act as a trusted advisor and interface to Project Leadership on procurement, contractual and commercial matters

• Ensure alignment with Bachem procurement standards, policies and governance requirements.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, Economics or a related discipline; additional qualifications in Procurement, Contract Management, Project Management, Commercial or Legal Management are a strong advantage.

• 10-15+ years of experience in Procurement, Commercial and Contract Management within large CAPEX projects, ideally in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemical, industrial manufacturing or construction sector.

• Proven track record in managing complex procurement packages, strategic suppliers and high-value commercial negotiations across major project delivery models (EPCM, EPC, Construction Management).

• Strong expertise in contract lifecycle management, claims management, change orders, dispute resolution and risk allocation.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional and matrix organizations, collaborating effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategic procurement mindset combined with strong commercial acumen, business judgment and decision-making capabilities.

• Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills, including executive-level interactions.

• Collaborative and resilient personality with a high level of ownership, accountability and the ability to drive results in demanding project environments.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines.

• Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with attractive internal career development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours, the possibility of working from home, and the option to purchase additional vacation days through a reduced workload arrangement

• Bachem AG covers 60% of pension fund contributions, with the option of enhanced retirement savings through our elective savings plan

• Access to employee benefits platforms offering discounts with external partners

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming a highly motivated professional who is eager to contribute to the successful establishment and operation of our new API manufacturing site in Sisslerfeld.

jobs.title: IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%
jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Service Delivery Manager (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Own core ITSM processes — Lead Incident, Problem, Configuration and Event Management globally, ensuring SLA compliance and alignment with SOPs/ITIL.

• Define performance metrics — Set KPIs/SLAs, build dashboards, deliver monthly reports and manage escalations

• Maintain process documentation — Create and update SOPs, training materials and ensure role clarity with tracked training records

• Drive Problem Management — Run RCA processes, remediation follow‑up, stakeholder communication and proactive risk identification

• Manage Known Errors — Maintain Key Issue databases and ensure workarounds are documented and shared

• Lead CMDB governance — Own CMDB strategy, CI lifecycle accuracy, data models and service dependency mapping

• Ensure CMDB data quality — Perform audits, reconciliation, issue resolution and integration with change/incident/monitoring processes

• Optimize CMDB tooling — Enhance CMDB/asset platform usage, automate via discovery tools and report on configuration compliance

• Run Event Management — Ensure monitoring coverage, correct event filtering/correlation and impact‑based escalation

• Define event automation — Maintain thresholds, notifications and automated/self‑healing responses

Your profile:

• 7+ years in IT Operations, Service Management or a related technical field, including Service Operations or Service Delivery Management

• Hands-on experience in Incident, Problem, Configuration and/or Event Management; Major Incident Management is an advantage

• ITIL Foundation certification required; ITIL Intermediate/Expert an asset.

• Strong cross-domain technical expertise across infrastructure, applications, databases, and security, with a deep understanding of their interdependencies—including modern workplace devices, application servers, and backend platforms

• Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, correlations and root causes, with the ability to lead technical RCA calls

• Excellent communication skills, translating technical detail into business- and user-friendly language

• Strong facilitation and leadership under pressure, with the ability to work across global teams and manage stakeholders at all levels

• Experience with monitoring, log analysis and service management platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, LogicMonitor).

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

jobs.title: IT Enterprise Architect, Manufacturing & Operations (a), 80-100%
jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Enterprise Architect (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Define and drive the Manufacturing Enterprise Architecture roadmap aligned with business strategy and GxP/regulatory requirements.

• Establish and govern architecture principles, standards, and technology roadmaps across global manufacturing programs

• Lead the technology architecture for new manufacturing facilities and the modernization of existing sites

• Design and oversee the integration architecture between OT, manufacturing systems, and enterprise platforms

• Ensure compliance with GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and other applicable pharmaceutical regulations

• Shape enterprise integration, API, middleware, and data platform strategies, including MDM and advanced analytics capabilities

• Enable real-time data exchange between manufacturing operations and business systems through Industry 4.0 technologies

• Drive digital manufacturing initiatives, including MES, digital twins, predictive maintenance, batch analytics, and eBR solutions

• Partner with senior business, engineering, quality, and regulatory stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business objectives

• Mentor architects, support strategic technology selections, and lead architectural governance, vendor evaluations, and due diligence activities

Your profile:

• 10+ years of progressive IT architecture experience, including 5+ years in a Senior/Principal Enterprise Architect role

• Proven experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry with strong knowledge of GxP, CSV/CSA, and regulatory requirements

• Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing environments, including greenfield and/or major brownfield facility projects

• Strong enterprise application architecture expertise, ideally with SAP S/4HANA

• Proven track record in designing and governing large-scale enterprise integration architectures and API ecosystems

• Experience defining and implementing enterprise data strategies, including data platforms, MDM, analytics, and data lake architecture

• Solid knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF); certification is an advantage

• Hands-on experience with digital manufacturing technologies such as MES, SCADA, DCS, eBR, LIMS, or related platforms

• Good understanding of Industry 4.0, OT/IT convergence, industrial cybersecurity, IoT, and advanced manufacturing concepts

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

• 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus

• Access to benefits platforms with discounts from external partners

• Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant

• A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

• Attiva lo scambio di dati in tempo reale tra operazioni di produzione e sistemi aziendali attraverso le tecnologie Industry 4.0

• Esperienza pratica con tecnologie di produzione digitali come MES, SCADA, DCS, eBR, LIMS o piattaforme correlate

• Buona comprensione di Industria 4.0, convergenza OT/IT, sicurezza informatica industriale, IoT e concetti di produzione avanzati

jobs.description:
Für unsere stetig wachsende Produktionskapazität suchen wir eine/n Spezialisten:in für Reinigungsvalidierungen für unseren Bereich Manufacturing & Process Technology (MPT) .
